title: A Generative AI-powered navigation system for precision CBCT-guided lung biopsies: a randomized controlled trial
zh_title: 生成式AI导航用于CBCT引导肺穿刺：随机对照试验
summary: 多中心随机对照试验显示，生成式AI肺穿刺导航系统可减少穿刺次数，并提升操作标准化与效率。
key_points: 开发并验证GPS-Lung肺穿刺导航系统
开展多中心随机对照试验（NCT06762613）
辅助下穿刺次数减少、操作流程更标准化
reason: 多中心RCT报告穿刺次数与流程结局，属重要档
abstract: Lung puncture biopsy is the gold standard for the qualitative diagnosis of lung nodules. Cone Beam CT (CBCT) is commonly used for guiding punctures to locate lung nodules. However, the poor quality of CBCT images and the limited intelligence of surgical guidance systems have lowered the efficiency of puncture procedures, particularly for small and complex lesions. This study developed and validated a robust and accurate Generative AI-Powered Puncture Surgery Navigation System for lung punctures (GPS-Lung), demonstrating clinical applicability through a multicenter randomized controlled trial (Registration number: NCT06762613). The clinical results showed significant improvements in surgeon performance with the assistance of the integrated GPS-Lung system. Specifically, the system facilitated a more standardized and efficient operational process, reducing number of punctures (2.0 ± 1.2 vs. 2.5 ± 1.7, P = 0.005), shortening operative time (20.4 ± 5.6 min vs. 23.2 ± 6.3 min, P = 0.001), decreasing radiation exposure (4357.4 ± 3427.3 μGy·m^2 vs. 5570.9 ± 4846.7 μGy·m^2, P = 0.033), and reducing pneumothorax complications (12.7% vs. 23.9%, P = 0.033). Taken together, the proposed system demonstrates promising clinical and translational value in lung nodule puncture intervention. (Clinical Trials Registration: NCT06762613). Clinical Trials Registration: NCT06762613, Registration Date: March 26, 2025. ( https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT06762613?term=NCT06762613&rank=1&tab=history ).
zh_abstract: 肺穿刺活检是肺结节定性诊断的金标准。锥形束CT（CBCT）常用于引导穿刺以定位肺结节。然而，CBCT图像质量较差以及手术引导系统智能化程度有限，降低了穿刺操作的效率，尤其对于小而复杂的病灶。本研究开发并验证了一种稳健且准确的生成式AI驱动的肺穿刺手术导航系统（GPS-Lung），并通过多中心随机对照试验证明了其临床适用性（注册号：NCT06762613）。临床结果显示，在集成GPS-Lung系统的辅助下，外科医生表现显著改善。具体而言，该系统促进了更标准化和高效的操作流程，减少了穿刺次数（2.0 ± 1.2 对 2.5 ± 1.7，P = 0.005），缩短了手术时间（20.4 ± 5.6 分钟 对 23.2 ± 6.3 分钟，P = 0.001），降低了辐射暴露（4357.4 ± 3427.3 μGy·m^2 对 5570.9 ± 4846.7 μGy·m^2，P = 0.033），并减少了气胸并发症（12.7% 对 23.9%，P = 0.033）。综上所述，所提出的系统在肺结节穿刺介入中展现出有前景的临床和转化价值。（临床试验注册：NCT06762613）。临床试验注册：NCT06762613，注册日期：2025年3月26日。（ https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT06762613?term=NCT06762613&rank=1&tab=history ）。

title: Multi-site real-world performance of commercial AI for pulmonary and incidental pulmonary embolism detection
zh_title: 商用AI检测肺栓塞与偶发肺栓塞多中心真实世界表现
summary: 17家机构回顾性评估两款FDA清关AI：肺栓塞分诊灵敏度86.8%、偶发肺栓塞73.5%，并报告亚组灵敏度下降。
key_points: 纳入CTPA 30678例、常规增强CT 37191例
肺栓塞模型灵敏度86.8%、特异度99.1%
亚段性及非急性肺栓塞灵敏度明显下降
参考标准由经验证LLM流程从报告提取
reason: 17机构、6万余例多中心外部验证并报告亚组性能，属重要档。
abstract: Pulmonary embolism (PE) is a leading cause of cardiovascular mortality, yet the real-world performance of FDA-cleared AI detection models remains incompletely characterized. We retrospectively evaluated two FDA-cleared AI algorithms from a single commercial platform (Aidoc Medical BriefCase)—one for PE triage on dedicated CT pulmonary angiography (CTPA; n = 30,678) and one for incidental PE (iPE) detection on routine contrast-enhanced CTs ( n = 37,191), across a 17-facility academic health system. Reference-standard labels were extracted from radiology reports using a validated LLM pipeline (97% accuracy, κ = 0.94). The PE model achieved 86.8% sensitivity and 99.1% specificity, with sensitivity declining from 99.3% for saddle emboli to 72.9% for subsegmental PE, and from 89.7% for acute to 65.3% for non-acute PE. The iPE model achieved 73.5% sensitivity and 99.8% specificity. Both models demonstrated lower sensitivity than FDA-clearance benchmarks while exceeding cleared specificity, with diminishing performance for peripheral and non-acute emboli mirroring known human reader limitations and underscoring the need for standardized post-market surveillance of AI-enabled medical devices.
zh_abstract: 肺栓塞（PE）是心血管死亡的主要原因，但FDA批准的AI检测模型在真实世界中的性能仍未被充分表征。我们回顾性评估了来自单一商业平台（Aidoc Medical BriefCase）的两个FDA批准的AI算法——一个用于专用CT肺动脉造影（CTPA；n = 30,678）上的PE分诊，另一个用于常规增强CT（n = 37,191）上的偶发PE（iPE）检测——覆盖一个包含17家机构的学术卫生系统。参考标准标签使用经验证的大语言模型（LLM）流程从放射学报告中提取（准确率97%，κ = 0.94）。PE模型达到86.8%的敏感性和99.1%的特异性，敏感性从骑跨型栓塞的99.3%下降到亚段性PE的72.9%，并从急性PE的89.7%下降到非急性PE的65.3%。iPE模型达到73.5%的敏感性和99.8%的特异性。两个模型的敏感性均低于FDA批准基准，同时特异性高于批准的特异性；对外周性和非急性栓塞的性能下降，反映了已知的人类阅片者局限性，并强调需要对AI赋能的医疗器械进行标准化的上市后监测。

title: Silent evaluation reveals context-dependent validity of automated metrics for AI-generated clinical messages
zh_title: 自动指标评价 AI 生成临床消息的效度依赖情境
summary: npj Digital Medicine 利用患者门户消息的分阶段上线，在 21,073 条展示组与 45,127 条未展示组消息上，比较 BLEU、ROUGE、BERTScore 等自动指标与医师盲评结果。
key_points: 30 名基层医生，2023 年 9 月至 2024 年 8 月分阶段上线
展示组 21,073 条，未展示组 45,127 条
自动指标与医师对有效性、误解与伤害的盲评相关性有限
reason: 大规模真实上线数据与人评对照，但为观察性评价，属值得一看档
abstract: Evaluation of AI-generated patient communication lacks standardized frameworks, and automated metrics may not reflect clinical utility. We leveraged a staged rollout of GPT-generated draft responses (GDRs) to patient portal messages. Thirty primary care physicians received drafts from September 2023 to August 2024 under two conditions: an intervention group where AI drafts were displayed and edited ( n = 21,073), and a non-displayed group where drafts were generated but never shown to physicians, who composed responses independently ( n = 45,127). We evaluated messages using BLEU, ROUGE, BERTScore, and Flesch Reading Ease, and then correlated automated metrics with blinded physician ratings of effectiveness, misunderstanding potential, and harm. In the intervention group, 2264 (11%) drafts were incorporated into final messages with high semantic alignment (BERTScore F1 = 0.93). In the non-displayed group, independent physician messages showed moderate similarity to unseen drafts (BERTScore F1 = 0.83). Despite comparable semantic scores, physicians preferred human-authored messages (4.24/5). BERTScore correlated with physician quality ratings in the intervention group but not in the non-displayed. Automated metrics demonstrated context-dependent validity; they assessed editing fidelity but failed to evaluate whether AI-generated content matches independent human performance. Rigorous evaluation of clinical generative AI requires validation of metric meaning within specific use contexts.
zh_abstract: 评估AI生成的患者沟通内容缺乏标准化框架，且自动化指标可能无法反映临床实用性。我们利用了一项分阶段推广：将GPT生成的草稿回复（GPT-generated draft responses, GDRs）用于患者门户消息。30名初级保健医生在2023年9月至2024年8月期间在两种条件下接收草稿：干预组中AI草稿被显示并可编辑（n = 21,073），以及非显示组中草稿被生成但从未向医生展示，由医生独立撰写回复（n = 45,127）。我们使用BLEU、ROUGE、BERTScore和Flesch Reading Ease评估消息，然后将自动化指标与盲法医师对有效性、误解可能性和伤害的评分进行相关性分析。在干预组中，2264份（11%）草稿被纳入最终消息，具有高语义一致性（BERTScore F1 = 0.93）。在非显示组中，医生独立撰写的消息与未展示的草稿显示出中等相似性（BERTScore F1 = 0.83）。尽管语义评分相当，医生更偏好人类撰写的消息（4.24/5）。BERTScore在干预组中与医师质量评分相关，但在非显示组中不相关。自动化指标表现出情境依赖的有效性；它们评估了编辑保真度，但未能评估AI生成内容是否与独立的人类表现相匹配。对临床生成式AI的严格评估需要在特定使用情境中验证指标含义。

title: Towards reliable morphological subtyping and cancer detection on Barrett’s esophagus pathology through ensembling foundation models
zh_title: 集成病理基础模型用于Barrett食管形态分型与癌检测
summary: 基于3528张全切片图像评估五种病理基础模型集成方案在Barrett食管分型与腺癌检测中的表现。
key_points: 790例患者3528张H&E全切片图像
五模型多放大倍率集成，分型AUROC 0.907
癌检测AUROC 0.909
reason: 同行评审、样本量可观且有基线对比，但未见外部独立验证，属值得一看档
abstract: The reliability of emergent histopathology foundation models (Histo-FMs) for real-world diagnostic tasks remains unproven. Given the complexity of diagnostic tasks and the challenges inherent in real-world data, we utilized Histo-FMs to investigate their utility for morphological subtyping of Barrett’s esophagus (BE) and detecting esophageal adenocarcinoma (EAC) across the BE progression spectrum. We benchmarked Histo-FMs on the BarrettNet cohort, spanning diagnostic categories ranging from normal to EAC (N2EAC). The dataset comprised 3528 hematoxylin and eosin (H&E)-stained whole-slide images (WSIs) from 790 patients. A multi-magnification, multi-backbone aggregation of the five most expert-consistent single-scale models yielded incremental performance gains (AUROC of 0.907, F1-score of 0.696, accuracy of 0.795, and κ of 0.651 for morphological subtyping; AUROC of 0.909, F1-score of 0.836, accuracy of 0.959, and κ of 0.673 for EAC detection), with non-uniform gains across single-model comparisons and limited benefit for dysplasia. The findings support the capability of Histo-FMs for BE morphological subtyping and EAC detection in a multicenter clinical cohort, while highlighting persistent challenges in dysplasia assessment and the need for external validation. This study provides a foundation for future clinical validation.
zh_abstract: 新兴的组织病理学基础模型（Histo-FMs）在真实世界诊断任务中的可靠性仍未得到证实。鉴于诊断任务的复杂性以及真实世界数据固有的挑战，我们利用Histo-FMs研究其在Barrett食管（BE）形态学分型以及在整个BE进展谱系中检测食管腺癌（EAC）方面的效用。我们在BarrettNet队列上对Histo-FMs进行基准测试，该队列涵盖从正常到EAC的诊断类别（N2EAC）。数据集包括来自790例患者的3528张苏木精-伊红（H&E）染色全切片图像（WSIs）。对五个与专家一致性最高的单尺度模型进行多放大倍数、多骨干网络聚合，带来了性能的增量提升（形态学分型：AUROC为0.907，F1分数为0.696，准确率为0.795，κ为0.651；EAC检测：AUROC为0.909，F1分数为0.836，准确率为0.959，κ为0.673），在单模型比较中提升不均匀，且对异型增生的益处有限。研究结果支持Histo-FMs在多中心临床队列中进行BE形态学分型和EAC检测的能力，同时凸显了异型增生评估中持续存在的挑战以及外部验证的必要性。本研究为未来的临床验证提供了基础。

title: Agentic artificial intelligence for code status extraction from clinical notes: a cross-model comparison of single agent, reflective agent, and multiagent extractor-reviewer system.
source: PubMed · Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA
zh_title: 智能体架构用于病历代码状态抽取的跨模型比较
summary: JAMIA 研究在 1000 份 MIMIC-IV 出院小结上，比较单智能体、自我反思与多智能体审阅三种架构对 DNR/DNI/CMO 的抽取表现。
key_points: 4 个开源大模型与 3 种智能体架构的受控对照
数据为 1000 份 MIMIC-IV 出院小结
金标准由医师与 AI 双人复核裁决，κ 为 0.98–0.99
reason: 设计规范的回顾性单数据集研究，仅内部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] To evaluate whether increasing agentic architectural complexity via self-reflection or multiagent design improves clinical code status extraction (Do Not Resuscitate [DNR], Do Not Intubate [DNI], Comfort Measures Only [CMO]) across open-source large language models (LLMs) of varying capabilities. We conducted a controlled cross-model comparison evaluating 3 architectures: (1) single extractor agent, (2) single agent with self-reflection, and (3) sequential multiagent extractor-reviewer system. Four open-source LLMs (DeepSeek-R1-Distill-LLaMA-8B, GPT-OSS-20B, MedGemma-27B-IT, Qwen3.5-27B) were evaluated on 1000 Medical Information Mart for Intensive Care IV-Note discharge summaries. Ground truth labels were established through a physician-AI dual review with adjudication (Cohen's κ = 0.98-0.99). Models were evaluated on accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, Cohen's κ, token consumption, and processing latency. McNemar's test was used for paired comparisons. For capable larger models (GPT-OSS-20B, MedGemma-27B-IT, Qwen3.5-27B), single-agent architectures achieved comparable or superior performance for explicit code status (DNR, DNI) relative to complex systems, whereas multiagent review doubled token consumption and latency without accuracy gains. Reflective self-review significantly impaired MedGemma-27B-IT on DNI extraction (P = .047). For the smaller DeepSeek-R1-Distill-LLaMA-8B, multiagent review provided statistically significant corrective benefits for DNR (P = .017) and CMO (P < .001), demonstrating a capability-threshold effect, though performance remained below clinically acceptable levels. Architectural complexity does not enhance extraction performance for capable LLMs, and reflective self-review may cause conservative overcorrection. Multiagent verification value is inversely related to model capability. Single-agent LLMs provide optimal accuracy and efficiency for explicit clinical extraction in capable models. Agentic complexity must be matched to both task characteristics and model capability rather than adopted by default.
zh_abstract: ［《美国医学信息学协会杂志：JAMIA》］评估通过自我反思或多智能体设计增加智能体架构复杂度，是否能在能力各异的开源大型语言模型（large language models, LLMs）中改善临床代码状态（code status）提取（不施行心肺复苏（Do Not Resuscitate [DNR]）、不插管（Do Not Intubate [DNI]）、仅舒适措施（Comfort Measures Only [CMO]））。我们进行了一项受控的跨模型比较，评估3种架构：（1）单一提取智能体；（2）带自我反思的单一智能体；（3）序贯多智能体提取器-审核器系统。四种开源LLM（DeepSeek-R1-Distill-LLaMA-8B、GPT-OSS-20B、MedGemma-27B-IT、Qwen3.5-27B）在1000份Medical Information Mart for Intensive Care IV-Note出院小结上进行评估。真实标签通过医师-AI双重审核并仲裁确定（Cohen's κ = 0.98-0.99）。模型按准确率、精确率、召回率、F1分数、Cohen's κ、token消耗和处理延迟进行评估。采用McNemar检验进行配对比较。对于能力较强的大型模型（GPT-OSS-20B、MedGemma-27B-IT、Qwen3.5-27B），单智能体架构在明确代码状态（DNR、DNI）方面相对于复杂系统达到相当或更优的性能，而多智能体审核使token消耗和处理延迟翻倍，且未带来准确率提升。反思性自我审核显著降低了MedGemma-27B-IT在DNI提取中的性能（P = .047）。对于较小的DeepSeek-R1-Distill-LLaMA-8B，多智能体审核对DNR（P = .017）和CMO（P < .001）提供了具有统计学显著性的纠正获益，表现出能力阈值效应，尽管性能仍低于临床可接受水平。架构复杂度并未提高能力较强LLM的提取性能，反思性自我审核可能导致保守性过度纠正。多智能体验证的价值与模型能力呈负相关。在能力较强的模型中，单智能体LLM可为明确的临床提取提供最佳准确性和效率。智能体复杂度必须与任务特征和模型能力相匹配，而不应默认采用。

title: Deep learning-based echocardiography for cardiac assessment: a systematic literature review and meta-analysis.
source: PubMed · European heart journal. Digital health
zh_title: 深度学习超声心动图心脏评估：系统综述与荟萃分析
summary: 系统综述纳入160项研究，汇总全自动深度学习超声心动图模型在疾病预测、测量复现、分割与视图分类中的表现及影响因素。
key_points: 检索16248篇文献，最终纳入160项研究
仅纳入对超声心动图动态图像的全自动DL模型
按疾病或死亡预测、测量复现、腔室分割、视图分类等分组

reason: 同行评审系统综述与荟萃分析，纳入160项研究且结论明确，达重要档
abstract: [European heart journal. Digital health] Artificial intelligence, particularly deep learning (DL), has shown significant potential for enhancing the assessment of echocardiograms in clinical practice. This systematic review and meta-analysis aimed to evaluate the performance of DL models and to identify factors affecting their performance. A systematic review of the PubMed, CENTRAL, and Web of Science databases was conducted, yielding 16 248 potential publications. Of these, 160 studies met the inclusion criteria. Only studies applying fully automated DL networks to echocardiographic loops were considered. Performance estimates were pooled using a random-effects meta-analysis. The studies were categorized into five distinct groups: prediction of disease or mortality, replication of established measures, segmentation of cardiac chambers, classification of chamber views, and assessment of image quality. High heterogeneity that could not be resolved was observed in studies focusing on cardiac chamber segmentation and classification. Model performance was influenced by a variety of different factors, including medical target and input characteristics such as video resolution, number of frames used, and total participants included during training. DL models achieve high performance across various applications in echocardiography. In selected tasks, they may reduce reliance on expert input and support greater automation of echocardiographic workflows. However, further validation, assessment of clinical utility, and evaluation in real-world settings are required before widespread clinical adoption.
zh_abstract: ［European heart journal. Digital health］人工智能，尤其是深度学习（DL），已显示出在临床实践中增强超声心动图评估的巨大潜力。本系统综述与荟萃分析旨在评估DL模型的性能，并识别影响其性能的因素。对PubMed、CENTRAL和Web of Science数据库进行了系统检索，共获得16 248篇潜在文献。其中，160项研究符合纳入标准。仅考虑将全自动DL网络应用于超声心动图动态图像（loops）的研究。采用随机效应荟萃分析汇总性能估计值。这些研究被分为五个不同组别：疾病或死亡预测、既定测量指标的复现、心腔分割、心腔切面分类以及图像质量评估。在聚焦心腔分割和分类的研究中，观察到无法解决的高度异质性。模型性能受到多种不同因素的影响，包括医学目标以及输入特征，如视频分辨率、所用帧数和训练期间纳入的总参与者数。DL模型在超声心动图的多种应用中均取得高性能。在选定任务中，它们可能减少对专家输入的依赖，并支持超声心动图工作流程更高程度的自动化。然而，在广泛临床采用之前，仍需进一步验证、评估临床效用并在真实世界环境中进行评价。

source: PubMed · Journal of medical Internet research

abstract: [Journal of medical Internet research] AI-based clinical decision support systems (AI-CDSSs) can help primary care clinicians provide higher quality care amid rising case complexity and resource constraints. However, evidence regarding their effectiveness and safety in primary care practice is lacking. We synthesized evidence on the effectiveness and safety of AI-CDSSs compared with usual care or non-AI-based systems in primary care settings. We conducted a systematic review following the Cochrane Handbook for Systematic Reviews of Interventions and reported the results according to PRISMA (Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses) 2020 guidelines. abstract: [Schizophrenia research] Following the development of widely accessible large language model-based chatbot systems, concerns have emerged that such systems may reinforce psychotic ideation through affirmation of delusional content. However, systematic evaluations of chatbot responses to psychotic scenarios remain limited. We hypothesized that chatbot responses would become increasingly affirmatory over repeated interactions with the user. To test this, we evaluated the responses of ChatGPT, DeepSeek and Replika to simulated psychosis scenarios. Conversations were conducted across seven consecutive days in two languages. Responses were coded for chatbot stance toward psychotic content, recommendation to seek clinical assessment, presence of follow-up questions, and additional advice. Mixed-effects and linear regression models were used, including cluster-robust linear probability models for binary outcomes. As simulated symptom severity increased across days, ChatGPT responses became less affirmatory, DeepSeek responses remained relatively stable, and Replika responses became more affirmatory; latter two trajectories differed significantly from ChatGPT. Response variability decreased for ChatGPT and Replika but increased for DeepSeek across days. The effects of language and symptom domain were non-significant. Recommendation rates differed significantly between systems. DeepSeek and Replika provided potentially harmful advice, including discontinuation of antipsychotic treatment, in 21% and 37% of conversations, respectively. These findings suggest that affirmation of psychotic ideation significantly varies across different chatbots and does not appear to be an unavoidable consequence of large language model deployment. Furthermore, they underscore the need for developing explicit safety standards governing chatbot responses to psychotic content.

abstract: [Breast cancer research and treatment] The purpose of this study is to evaluate the potential impact of a Food and Drug Administration (FDA)-cleared artificial intelligence (AI)-based decision support tool for breast ultrasound in reducing benign biopsies. This study was conducted at two academic medical centers from March to May 2025 following the clinical implementation of an FDA-cleared AI-based decision support tool for breast ultrasound interpretation (Koios DS; New York, NY). Fourteen breast imaging radiologists documented BI-RADS 4 (suspicious) cases, along with the corresponding AI output. AI assessments were compared with biopsy pathology results to characterize AI classification within this selected cohort. Overall, 271 lesions in 253 women (mean age, 54 years; range, 24-92 years) were categorized as BI-RADS 4 and were biopsied, aspirated, and/or surgically excised. Of these, 23.2% (63/271) yielded malignant pathology, while 76.8% (208/271) were benign. The AI tool classified 90.5% (57/63) of malignant lesions as BI-RADS 4 and 9.5% (6/63) as BI-RADS 2 or 3. Among benign cases, the AI tool assigned 41.8% (87/208) as BI-RADS 2 (benign), 18.8% (39/208) as BI-RADS 3 (probably benign), and 39.4% (82/208) as BI-RADS 4 (suspicious). Retrospective application of the AI output to biopsy triage decisions suggests the potential for reduction in benign biopsy recommendations, with 60.6% (126/208) of benign lesions classified by the AI tool as BI-RADS 2 or 3. AI may help reduce benign biopsy recommendations among lesions assessed as BI-RADS 4 by radiologists; however, careful integration with radiologist judgment and clinical history is essential to ensure timely cancer diagnosis.

abstract: [No shinkei geka. Neurological surgery] Artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) are increasingly used in acute ischemic stroke. Their clinical value depends not only on diagnostic accuracy but also on whether these systems improve time-critical decision-making. Current applications include prehospital triage, detection of large-vessel and medium-vessel occlusions, automated ASPECTS assessment, estimation of ischemic core and penumbra, collateral evaluation, and workflow notification using CT, CT angiography, CT perfusion, and MRI. AI is also being investigated to predict treatment response, futile recanalization, symptomatic intracranial hemorrhage, brain edema, and final infarct volume after reperfusion therapy. In clinical practice, prognostic prediction must be distinguished from treatment-effect prediction. Useful AI systems should report uncertainty and calibration and provide actionable outputs at the clinically relevant time point while remaining embedded in a human-in-the-loop workflow. Future multimodal platforms may integrate imaging, clinical data, transfer information, procedure-related variables, and device characteristics to support individualized acute stroke workflows and endovascular procedural planning.

abstract: [Journal of transcultural nursing : official journal of the Transcultural Nursing Society] Language barriers perpetuate health care disparities, yet traditional data sources overlook inequities in relationship‑based care. This study uses artificial intelligence to examine language‑related disparities in spiritual care, a domain largely documented in unstructured clinical notes. We analyzed electronic health records of 7,360 deceased adults aged ≥65 years from a tertiary hospital (2010-2023). Natural language processing identified spiritual care documentation, and structured flowsheets captured formal chaplain visits. Logistic regression assessed associations between patient language and spiritual care access and timing. Non‑English speakers had 59% lower odds of receiving formal spiritual care (odds ratio = 0.41, p = .003) and received support nearly 10 months later (median 136 vs. 432 days, p = .020). Among non‑English speakers, non-chaplain providers more often first documented spiritual needs. Artificial intelligence-supported analysis of unstructured documentation revealed language‑related disparities missed by structured data, offering a culturally grounded approach to identifying inequities in relationship‑based care.

abstract: [Scientific data] Tissue macrophages are highly versatile immune cells whose morphologies shift dramatically depending on their activation state and tissue environment. This morphological plasticity reflects their diverse origins and functions but also poses significant challenges for both manual and automated image analysis. In the skin, macrophages display particularly intricate shapes, ranging from rounded to highly elongated, irregular, and non-convex forms. We developed a deep learning-based approach for the automated identification, 3D segmentation, and quantitative morphological profiling of dermal tissue macrophages in mice, facilitating large-scale analysis of cellular volume and elongation. This allowed us to build a dataset of 3D-segmented dermal tissue macrophages, comprising 947 single cells. To ensure accuracy, automatically generated segmentations were refined using a custom-designed Napari plugin. To illustrate technical validity and potential reuse, we quantified macrophage volume and elongation in adult steady-state and five-day post-Staphylococcus aureus infection samples, showing that the dataset captures biologically interpretable morphological variation.
zh_abstract: [科学数据] 组织巨噬细胞是高度多能的免疫细胞，其形态会随激活状态和组织环境发生显著变化。这种形态可塑性反映了其多样的起源和功能，但也对人工和自动图像分析构成重大挑战。在皮肤中，巨噬细胞呈现尤其复杂的形状，从圆形到高度伸长、不规则和非凸形态不等。我们开发了一种基于深度学习的方法，用于小鼠真皮组织巨噬细胞的自动识别、三维分割和定量形态学分析，促进细胞体积和伸长的大规模分析。这使我们能够构建一个三维分割的真皮组织巨噬细胞数据集，包含 947 个单细胞。为确保准确性，自动生成的分割结果使用定制设计的 Napari 插件进行了精修。为说明技术有效性和潜在复用性，我们在成年稳态样本和金黄色葡萄球菌（Staphylococcus aureus）感染后五天样本中量化了巨噬细胞体积和伸长，表明该数据集捕获了具有生物学可解释性的形态变异。

abstract: [Journal of imaging informatics in medicine] Benign paroxysmal positional vertigo (BPPV) is the most common cause of vestibular vertigo, yet accurate diagnosis remains challenging without specialist expertise. This study aimed to develop and evaluate an artificial intelligence (AI)-based diagnostic algorithm for BPPV using video-nystagmography (VNG) recordings. A total of 1352 VNG recordings were collected from patients with posterior semicircular canal (PSCC) BPPV (n = 234), lateral semicircular canal (LSCC) BPPV (canalolithiasis, n = 188; cupulolithiasis, n = 58), and healthy controls (n = 224) at a single tertiary referral hospital, yielding 1738 signal segments (1312 nystagmus segments annotated by two otolaryngologists and 426 normal segments). Eye trajectory signals were extracted using a deep learning-based VNG eye-tracking algorithm, transformed into two-dimensional (2D) scalogram representations via continuous wavelet transform (CWT), and classified using task-specific backbone architectures selected through systematic comparison under a patient-level data split. Ablation analysis showed that CWT-based 2D representations significantly outperformed raw one-dimensional (1D) time-series baselines. The final models achieved area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) values of 0.974 for horizontal and 0.961 for torsional nystagmus classification. For BPPV subtype diagnosis, recording-level accuracy was 0.935 for the PSCC and 0.938 for the LSCC evaluation; F1-scores exceeded 0.84 for all PSCC classes and ranged from 0.59 to 0.98 for LSCC classes, with canalolithiasis variants outperforming cupulolithiasis variants. These findings suggest the feasibility of AI-assisted BPPV diagnosis from VNG recordings.
zh_abstract: [Journal of imaging informatics in medicine] 良性阵发性位置性眩晕（BPPV）是前庭性眩晕最常见的原因，但若无专科专业知识，准确诊断仍然具有挑战性。本研究旨在开发并评估一种基于人工智能（AI）的 BPPV 诊断算法，使用视频眼震图（VNG）记录。共从一家三级转诊医院的患者中收集了 1352 份 VNG 记录：后半规管（PSCC）BPPV（n = 234）、水平半规管（LSCC）BPPV（管石症，n = 188；顶石症，n = 58）以及健康对照（n = 224），共产生 1738 个信号片段（1312 个由两名耳鼻咽喉科医师标注的眼震片段和 426 个正常片段）。使用基于深度学习的 VNG 眼动追踪算法提取眼动轨迹信号，通过连续小波变换（CWT）转换为二维（2D）尺度图表示，并在患者水平数据划分下，通过系统比较选择的任务特异性骨干架构进行分类。消融分析显示，基于 CWT 的 2D 表示显著优于原始一维（1D）时间序列基线。最终模型在水平眼震分类中的受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）为 0.974，在扭转眼震分类中为 0.961。对于 BPPV 亚型诊断，PSCC 评估的记录水平准确率为 0.935，LSCC 评估为 0.938；所有 PSCC 类别的 F1 分数均超过 0.84，LSCC 类别的 F1 分数范围为 0.59 至 0.98，其中管石症变异型优于顶石症变异型。这些发现表明基于 VNG 记录进行 AI 辅助 BPPV 诊断的可行性。

title: From Canon to Nikon: Camera Domain Shift and Potential Equity Implications in Retinal AI
zh_title: 视网膜AI的相机域偏移与公平性
summary: 巴西8524例队列显示相机品牌影响视网膜图像质量，并评估AI跨相机性能差异。
key_points: 巴西8524例患者视网膜图像队列
Nikon图像质量不足概率超Canon两倍
在12项疾病分类等条件下评估域偏移
reason: 大样本队列分析相机域偏移与公平性，预印本无外部验证，属值得一看档。
abstract: Diabetic retinopathy is a leading cause of preventable blindness, yet access to regular screening remains limited worldwide. AI offers a scalable approach, but its performance can be sensitive to image quality and acquisition conditions. In a Brazilian cohort of 8,524 patients, retinal images acquired with the Nikon NF5050 were more than twice as likely to have inadequate image quality compared with those acquired with the Canon CR-2, despite refurbished Canon systems costing more than twice as much as Nikon systems. This potential cost-quality trade-off highlights an important consideration for the reliability of AI systems deployed across heterogeneous imaging systems. Using a frozen pretrained retinal foundation model, we systematically evaluate whether camera-associated performance differences persist across 12 retinal disease classification tasks, four input resolutions, and five downstream classifiers. We find that camera-associated performance differences vary substantially across tasks, and that neither higher input resolution nor classifier choice consistently mitigates cross-camera variation. These findings identify camera platform as a potentially overlooked source of performance variability, with implications for the safety and reliability of retinal AI when deployed across heterogeneous imaging systems. We release all source code, evaluation scripts, and per-task results on GitHub to support reproducible benchmarking.
zh_abstract: 糖尿病视网膜病变是可预防性失明的主要原因，但全球范围内定期筛查的可及性仍然有限。AI提供了一种可扩展的方法，但其性能可能对图像质量和采集条件敏感。在一个包含8,524名患者的巴西队列中，与使用Canon CR-2采集的视网膜图像相比，使用Nikon NF5050采集的视网膜图像出现图像质量不合格的可能性高出两倍以上，尽管翻新的Canon系统成本比Nikon系统高出一倍以上。这种潜在的成本-质量权衡凸显了在异构成像系统中部署AI系统时可靠性的一个重要考虑因素。使用冻结的预训练视网膜基础模型，我们系统评估了与相机相关的性能差异是否在12项视网膜疾病分类任务、四种输入分辨率和五种下游分类器中持续存在。我们发现，与相机相关的性能差异在不同任务间差异很大，并且更高的输入分辨率或分类器选择均不能持续减轻跨相机变异。这些发现表明，相机平台是一个可能被忽视的性能变异来源，这对视网膜AI在异构成像系统中部署时的安全性和可靠性具有意义。我们在GitHub上发布所有源代码、评估脚本和每项任务结果，以支持可重复的基准测试。

title: Scaling Therapy Supervision: Assessing Psychotherapy Fidelity Using Large Language Models
zh_title: 用大模型规模化评估心理治疗依从性
summary: 预印本用开源权重LLM从真实长程治疗转录自动评估心理治疗依从性并生成督导反馈，在独立RCT数据上验证外部构念效度。
key_points: 依从性评估受限于人工专家审阅，难以规模化
评估三种开源模型与多种任务分解、推理策略
证据优先推理可提升依从性估计表现
在独立随机对照试验数据上验证外部效度
reason: 预印本但有独立RCT数据外部验证，超出仅内部验证，值得一看偏上
abstract: Psychotherapy fidelity assessment measures how faithfully a therapist adheres to a treatment protocol, a critical determinant of positive patient outcomes. However, fidelity assessment is bottlenecked by manual expert review, rendering the process labor-intensive and unscalable. To scale therapy supervision and support clinician self-learning, we present an integrated application of large language models (LLMs) that automates psychotherapy fidelity workflows and generates actionable supervisory feedback from authentic, long-form clinical transcripts. We evaluate three open-weight models across multiple task decomposition configurations and reasoning strategies, demonstrating that evidence-first reasoning improves fidelity estimation. Furthermore, we establish the framework's external construct validity on an independent randomized controlled trial (RCT), where it reliably distinguishes Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) from non-CBT sessions across core therapeutic skills. Through a user study that evaluates the generated feedback, mental health experts indicate that the pipeline synthesizes actionable clinical feedback. Ultimately, our work offers a practical, scalable solution toward bridging the community mental health supervision gap.
zh_abstract: 心理治疗保真度评估衡量治疗师对治疗方案的遵循程度，而这是患者获得积极结局的关键决定因素。然而，保真度评估受制于人工专家审查，使该过程劳动密集且难以扩展。为扩大治疗督导规模并支持临床医生自学，我们提出一种大型语言模型（LLMs）的集成应用，可自动化心理治疗保真度工作流程，并从真实的长篇临床转录文本中生成可操作的督导反馈。我们在多种任务分解配置和推理策略下评估了三个开放权重模型，证明证据优先推理可改善保真度估计。此外，我们在一个独立随机对照试验（RCT）上确立了该框架的外部构念效度，在其中它能够在核心治疗技能上可靠地区分认知行为治疗（CBT）与非CBT会谈。通过一项评估所生成反馈的用户研究，心理健康专家指出该流程可综合出可操作的临床反馈。最终，我们的工作提供了一种实用、可扩展的解决方案，以弥合社区心理健康督导缺口。

title: BRIDGE: An Acceptance Gate to Block False Improvements in Model Updates, with a Retrospective Clinical Evaluation
zh_title: BRIDGE：阻断模型更新虚假提升的验收门
summary: 提出模型无关的验收门BRIDGE，用交叉拟合与bootstrap下界判断更新是否真提升；回顾性临床评估显示虚假提升率从20%降至0%。
key_points: 模型无关验收门，固定设置判断更新
交叉拟合降低选择偏差，下界需超裕度
12项回顾性临床任务虚假提升率20%→0%
reason: 多数据集回顾性验证加方法新颖，属值得一看档上沿
abstract: Models are updated repeatedly, and an update that looks better on validation data but not on new data is a false improvement that can misguide clinical decisions. The naive rule accepts every positive validation gain and is optimistic when the same data choose and judge the update. BRIDGE is a model-agnostic acceptance gate that decides each update from predictions and the available labels, with fixed settings. Each fold of the data judges the update chosen on the other folds (cross-fitting) to reduce selection bias; acceptance requires the gain's lower bootstrap bound to exceed a margin. The four settings are (A) 11 new datasets, (B) synthetic tasks, (C) 12 retrospective clinical tasks, and (D) 39 supporting datasets. The false-improvement rate falls from 19.1% (naive) to 1.1% (BRIDGE) in (A), 20.7% to 1.7% (B), 20.0% to 0% (C), and 12.5% to 0.5% (D); every 95% confidence interval of the reduction over datasets or tasks excludes zero (not over the clinical sources). An equal-size random draw from the naive acceptances contains more false improvements in (A)-(E) (post hoc, p<0.001). On the OpenML collection (E) of 14 new datasets, the false-improvement rate falls from 25.6% to 1.0%. BRIDGE removes 97% to 100% of the false improvements that the naive rule accepts, and its mean gain per deployed update is 1.8 to 3.1 times the naive rule's. The 95% upper bound on the false-improvement rate is below 5.5%: formal in (B) for independent tasks (3.56%), and conditional on the real data tested (0.33% to 5.40%).
zh_abstract: 模型会被反复更新，而一个在验证数据上看起来更好、但在新数据上并不更好的更新是假改善，可能误导临床决策。朴素规则接受每一个阳性验证增益，并且在相同数据既选择又评判更新时过于乐观。BRIDGE 是一种模型无关的接受门控，根据预测和可用标签以固定设置决定每次更新是否接受。数据的每一折评判在其他折上选出的更新（交叉拟合），以减少选择偏倚；接受要求增益的 bootstrap 下界超过一个裕度。四种设置为（A）11 个新数据集，（B）合成任务，（C）12 个回顾性临床任务，（D）39 个支持数据集。在（A）中，假改善率从 19.1%（朴素）降至 1.1%（BRIDGE），在（B）中从 20.7% 降至 1.7%，在（C）中从 20.0% 降至 0%，在（D）中从 12.5% 降至 0.5%；跨数据集或任务计算出的降低幅度的每个 95% 置信区间均不包含零（并非跨临床来源）。从朴素规则接受的更新中等量随机抽取，在（A）至（E）中包含更多假改善（事后检验，p<0.001）。在包含 14 个新数据集的 OpenML 集合（E）上，假改善率从 25.6% 降至 1.0%。BRIDGE 去除了朴素规则所接受假改善的 97% 至 100%，且其每次部署更新的平均增益是朴素规则的 1.8 至 3.1 倍。假改善率的 95% 上界低于 5.5%：该上界在（B）中针对独立任务为形式化结果（3.56%），并在所测试真实数据条件下为（0.33% 至 5.40%）。

title: Brain2Vec: A Self-Supervised 3D Foundation Model for Structural Brain MRI
zh_title: Brain2Vec：结构脑MRI自监督3D基础模型
summary: 在74,425例T1加权脑MRI上自监督预训练的3D基础模型，可微调或作特征提取器。
key_points: 预训练数据为多研究汇总的74,425例T1脑MRI
脑龄预测任务中微调收敛更快、精度更高
冻结嵌入优于按解剖定义体积的特征
reason: 大规模自监督预训练预印本，但下游仅脑龄任务、无外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Deep learning models have become essential tools in medical imaging, yet training them end-to-end for diverse tasks remains challenging due to limited labeled data and computational constraints. To address this, we introduce Brain2Vec, a foundation model pre-trained on 74,425 T1-weighted Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) scans pooled from multiple studies. Brain2Vec can serve both as a weight initialization backbone for fine-tuning downstream tasks and as a standalone feature extractor. We evaluated Brain2Vec in three tasks: downstream predictive performance, convergence speed, and embedding quality. Using Brain2Vec's pretrained weights as initialization and fine-tuning on labeled data for a brain age prediction task, results demonstrate improved final accuracy and faster convergence compared to random initialization. Additionally, its frozen embeddings outperform anatomically defined volumetric features on four of five downstream classification tasks and perform competitively with a state-of-the-art foundation model pre-trained on substantially more data. Lastly, we show that Brain2Vec encodes information primarily from a spatially localized and neuroanatomically meaningful set of brain regions, and that manipulating a subset of latent features produces monotonic, region-specific effects on the reconstructed anatomy. Brain2Vec code and trained models are available as an open-source package on https://github.com/CBICA/Brain2Vec. Users can apply Brain2Vec locally by installing the package, or directly through the NiChart cloud platform https://cloud.neuroimagingchart.com, where Brain2Vec features can be derived without requiring local installation or specialized infrastructure.
zh_abstract: 深度学习模型已成为医学影像中不可或缺的工具，然而由于标注数据有限和计算约束，针对多样任务对其进行端到端训练仍然具有挑战性。为解决这一问题，我们提出 Brain2Vec，这是一个在来自多项研究的 74,425 例 T1 加权磁共振成像（MRI）扫描上预训练的基础模型。Brain2Vec 既可作为用于微调下游任务的权重初始化骨干，也可作为独立的特征提取器。我们在三项任务中评估了 Brain2Vec：下游预测性能、收敛速度和嵌入质量。将 Brain2Vec 的预训练权重用作初始化，并在脑龄预测任务的标注数据上进行微调，结果显示，与随机初始化相比，其最终准确率更高且收敛更快。此外，在五项下游分类任务中的四项上，其冻结嵌入优于按解剖学定义的体积特征，并与一个在显著更多数据上预训练的最先进基础模型表现相当。最后，我们表明 Brain2Vec 编码的信息主要来自一组空间上局灶且具有神经解剖学意义的大脑区域，并且操纵潜在特征的一个子集会对重建的解剖结构产生单调的、区域特异性的效应。Brain2Vec 代码和训练好的模型作为开源包可在 https://github.com/CBICA/Brain2Vec 获取。用户可通过安装该包在本地应用 Brain2Vec，或直接通过 NiChart 云平台 https://cloud.neuroimagingchart.com 使用；在该平台上无需本地安装或专门基础设施即可提取 Brain2Vec 特征。

title: VGL-stGen: Learning a shared multimodal model for lung histology and spatial transcriptomics
zh_title: 肺组织学与空间转录组共享多模态模型
summary: VGL-stGen将医学视觉语言模型适配于肺H&E与空间转录组，支持多任务预测。
key_points: 整合图像-表达与表达-细胞类型配对
单检查点覆盖十三项评估任务
可输出分类、基因列表与表达水平
reason: 预印本新模型，多任务设计但缺外部验证，属值得一看上档
abstract: VGL-stGen is a multimodal large language model adapted from a pretrained medical vision-language model using paired lung H&E and spatial transcriptomics with single-cell references. Training integrates image-expression and expression-cell-type pairs, and gene-conditioned pseudo-labels transfer transcriptomic cell-type supervision to histology images. One deployed checkpoint supports thirteen evaluated tasks spanning tissue and cell-type classification, gene prediction and conditional expression completion from combinations of histology, cell identity and observed gene expression. Task-specific decoding produces categorical labels, gene lists and structured expression levels. For conditional completion, fixing queried gene identities and predicting their levels autoregressively improves structured prediction. Controlled adaptation shows that restricting supervision to requested expression-level tokens can further improve image-conditioned completion. Image-permutation experiments indicate that correctly paired histology adds information beyond observed expression. External classification relies partly on computational references with shared annotation lineage, and some H&E sources were exposed during cancer training or model development. Within these conditions, VGL-stGen demonstrates how a medical vision-language backbone can learn from spatial transcriptomics and histology to connect tissue morphology and molecular states through shared generative modeling.
zh_abstract: VGL-stGen是一种多模态大型语言模型，基于配对的肺部H&E和空间转录组学及单细胞参考，从预训练的医学视觉-语言模型适配而来。训练整合了图像-表达和表达-细胞类型配对，基因条件伪标签将转录组细胞类型监督迁移到组织学图像。一个部署的检查点支持十三项评估任务，涵盖组织和细胞类型分类、基因预测，以及基于组织学、细胞身份和观测基因表达组合的条件表达补全。任务特定解码产生分类标签、基因列表和结构化表达水平。对于条件补全，固定所查询基因的身份并自回归预测其水平可改善结构化预测。受控适配表明，将监督限制为所请求的表达水平标记可进一步改善图像条件补全。图像置换实验表明，正确配对的组织学信息在观测表达之外增加了信息。外部分类部分依赖于具有共享注释谱系的计算参考，并且一些H&E来源在癌症训练或模型开发期间已被暴露。在这些条件下，VGL-stGen展示了医学视觉-语言骨干如何从空间转录组学和组织学中学习，通过共享生成建模连接组织形态和分子状态。

title: Africa-Papers: A 10-Billion-Token Multi-Domain Academic Corpus for African Foundation Language Models
zh_title: Africa-Papers：泛非多领域学术预训练语料
summary: 构建含84万余篇全文、101.5亿token的泛非多领域学术语料，用于非洲基础语言模型预训练。
key_points: 含844,807篇全文，共101.5亿token
覆盖医学、法律、农业等多领域
称现有主流语料非洲内容占比不足0.5%
reason: 大规模语料数据集，但非医学专用且未见外部评测，属值得一看档。
abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) depend fundamentally on the diversity, depth, and factual rigor of their pre-training corpora. However, contemporary foundational pre-training datasets (such as The Pile, S2ORC, and Dolma) exhibit a severe structural omission: African scientific, medical, legal, and agricultural scholarship constitutes less than 0.5% of global pre-training tokens. Consequently, state-of-the-art models suffer from systematic failure modes when reasoning about tropical epidemiology, localized smallholder agro-ecologies, regional economic governance, and indigenous linguistic structures. To resolve this representation deficit and advance African intellectual sovereignty in artificial intelligence, we introduce Africa-Papers, the largest curated multi-domain Pan-African academic pre-training corpus to date. Comprising over 844,807 full-text papers spanning 10.15 billion tokens across 879 Parquet shards, Africa-Papers unifies four primary scientific streams: (1) continental peer-reviewed journals indexed in DOAJ across 31 African nations, (2) the CGIAR CGSpace agricultural repository, (3) African-authored and African-focused STEM/AI preprints on arXiv, and (4) open-access international publications by scholars affiliated with African institutions indexed via OpenAlex. The entire corpus is processed into layout-aware, clean Markdown preserving section hierarchies, mathematical equations, and tabular data, accompanied by exact BPE token counts and a standardized 8-domain taxonomy. We release Africa-Papers openly on the Hugging Face Hub under the AfriSpeech organization to accelerate continual pre-training and domain evaluation for foundation models globally.
zh_abstract: 大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）从根本上依赖于其预训练语料库的多样性、深度和事实严谨性。然而，当代基础预训练数据集（如 The Pile、S2ORC 和 Dolma）存在严重的结构性缺失：非洲的科学、医学、法律和农业学术成果占全球预训练 token 的比例不足 0.5%。因此，最先进的模型在推理热带流行病学、地方化小农农业生态、区域经济治理和本土语言结构时，会遭受系统性失效模式。为解决这一表征缺失并推进非洲在人工智能领域的知识主权，我们提出 Africa-Papers，这是迄今为止最大的经过整理的多领域泛非学术预训练语料库。Africa-Papers 包含超过 844,807 篇全文论文，横跨 101.5 亿个 token，分布于 879 个 Parquet 分片，整合了四个主要科学来源：（1）在 31 个非洲国家范围内被 DOAJ 收录的非洲大陆同行评审期刊；（2）CGIAR CGSpace 农业仓储库；（3）arXiv 上由非洲作者撰写或以非洲为主题的 STEM/AI 预印本；（4）通过 OpenAlex 索引的、由非洲机构附属学者发表的开放获取国际出版物。整个语料库被处理为布局感知的干净 Markdown，保留章节层级、数学公式和表格数据，并附带精确的 BPE token 计数和标准化的 8 领域分类体系。我们在 Hugging Face Hub 上通过 AfriSpeech 组织公开释放 Africa-Papers，以加速全球基础模型的持续预训练和领域评估。

title: Opportunities and challenges of artificial intelligence and digital pathology in adult CNS tumors.
zh_title: AI与数字病理在成人中枢神经系统肿瘤中的机遇与挑战
summary: 叙述性综述梳理2021 WHO整合诊断背景下AI与数字病理在成人CNS肿瘤临床应用的机会与挑战。
key_points: WHO第五版将分子特征置于组织学之上
AI在数字化切片上增加计算层
讨论临床与神经肿瘤学落地障碍
reason: 叙述性综述、无原始数据或验证，综述上限档内偏低。
abstract: [Journal of neuro-oncology] For over a century, the pathologist's interpretation at the microscope was the final word on a brain tumor's identity. The 2021 World Health Organization (WHO) classification of central nervous system (CNS) tumors, 5th edition, changed that hierarchy by introducing a layered, integrated diagnosis in which molecular findings take precedence over histology when the two conflict. Artificial intelligence (AI) applied to digitized slides adds a computational layer to this framework and marks a fundamental change in diagnostic workflow. This review examines the role of AI and digital pathology in adult CNS tumors and discusses the opportunities and challenges in clinical, neuro-oncology implementation. We conducted a narrative review of relevant literature indexed in PubMed before and after the 2021 WHO classification, covering digital pathology, whole-slide imaging (WSI), and AI applications in adult neuro-oncology. We synthesized evidence on diagnostic performance, molecular prediction, prognostic modeling, workflow integration, and ethical considerations. AI and digital pathology show potential to improve diagnostic consistency, shorten turnaround time, and integrate histopathological, molecular, and radiological information. AI models may support glioma grading, prediction of molecular alterations from routine histology, survival stratification, prediction of brain metastasis, and intraoperative decisions. Barriers to clinical adoption include limited generalizability, lack of transparency, data privacy, and evolving regulatory oversight. AI and digital pathology are transforming adult CNS tumor diagnostics and could improve precision, efficiency, and multidisciplinary decision-making. Successful implementation will require rigorous multi-institutional clinical validation, transparent governance, equitable access, and collaboration among patients and health care professionals.

abstract: [Advances in clinical and experimental medicine : official organ Wroclaw Medical University] This editorial discusses how health misinformation and disinformation combine long-established narratives with new technologies that substantially increase the speed, reach, personalization, and apparent credibility of misleading content. The novelty of the contemporary information environment lies less in entirely new false narratives than in digital infrastructures that allow misleading content to be created, tailored, disseminated, and monetized at unprecedented scale. Online social media platforms and generative artificial intelligence (AI) have transformed these conditions, enabling misleading health information to be created and disseminated at previously impossible scale and speed. Health misinformation and disinformation can influence behavior, undermine trust in scientific and public health institutions, delay appropriate care, promote ineffective or harmful interventions, and weaken responses to disease outbreaks. Their effects may be particularly pronounced among populations with limited access to reliable information, healthcare, and trusted institutions. This editorial also examines how engagement-driven platform design, commercial and political incentives, synthetic media, and inconsistent safeguards amplify the problem. It argues that fact-checking and individual media literacy, while necessary, are insufficient on their own. A more effective response requires timely, transparent public health communication; institutional support for healthcare professionals; greater platform accountability; systematic safety evaluation of generative AI; independent access to relevant data; and policies that address the incentives sustaining the production and circulation of false and misleading health information.
zh_abstract: [《临床与实验医学进展：弗罗茨瓦夫医科大学官方刊物》（Advances in clinical and experimental medicine : official organ Wroclaw Medical University）] 这篇社论讨论了健康错误信息与虚假信息如何将长期存在的叙事与新技术相结合，从而大幅提高误导性内容的速度、覆盖范围、个性化程度和表面可信度。当代信息环境的新颖之处较少在于全新的虚假叙事，而更多在于数字基础设施，这些基础设施使误导性内容能够以前所未有的规模被创建、定制、传播和变现。在线社交媒体平台和生成式人工智能（AI）改变了这些条件，使误导性健康信息能够以前所未有的规模和速度被创建和传播。健康错误信息与虚假信息可以影响行为、削弱对科学和公共卫生机构的信任、延迟适当照护、促进无效或有害的干预措施，并削弱对疾病暴发的应对。在难以获得可靠信息、医疗保健和可信机构的人群中，其影响可能尤为明显。这篇社论还审视了参与度驱动的平台设计、商业和政治激励、合成媒体以及不一致的保障措施如何放大这一问题。文章认为，事实核查和个人媒体素养虽然必要，但仅靠它们自身还不够。更有效的应对需要及时、透明的公共卫生沟通；对医疗保健专业人员的机构支持；更强的平台问责制；对生成式 AI 的系统性安全评估；对相关数据的独立获取；以及解决维持虚假和误导性健康信息生产与流通的激励因素的政策。

abstract: [Zhongguo fei ai za zhi = Chinese journal of lung cancer] Lung cancer remains the malignant tumor with the highest incidence and mortality rates worldwide, with non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) accounting for approximately 85% of cases. Radical surgical resection serves as the primary curative modality for patients with resectable NSCLC; however, postoperative recurrence persists in a subset of patients, thereby compromising long-term survival outcomes. Consequently, the precise prediction of postoperative recurrence risk, identification of high-risk populations, and formulation of individualized adjuvant therapy and surveillance strategies are of paramount importance for improving patient prognosis. In recent years, fueled by the rapid evolution of artificial intelligence (AI) and liquid biopsy technologies, the prediction of postoperative recurrence in NSCLC has progressively transitioned toward greater precision and personalization. This review summarizes the current applications of traditional predictive models, AI-based models, and liquid biopsy techniques in forecasting NSCLC recurrence following surgery, evaluating their respective strengths and limitations. Furthermore, it provides insights into future research trajectories. .

abstract: [Journal of dentistry] To determine whether buccal plaque coverage measured automatically from disclosed intraoral photographs agrees with the Turesky-modified Quigley-Hein plaque index (T-QHPI) scored by calibrated dentists. Twenty adults were photographed in one frontal and two lateral views after 48 hours without oral hygiene, and a calibrated dentist, blind to the model, scored the T-QHPI on the same teeth. Two U-Net (ResNet-34) models, one per view, were trained under participant-level five-fold cross-validation, and coverage was the stained percentage of each outlined buccal crown. Coverage was compared with the clinical grade by Spearman's ρ and, after conversion to T-QHPI grades under index-definition and calibrated thresholds, by weighted κ; participant means by Pearson's r, the intraclass correlation coefficient ICC(2,1) and Bland-Altman analysis. 438 teeth were compared with the clinical grade. Segmentation Dice was 0.88 in both views. Coverage ranked teeth with the clinical index at ρ = 0.856 (95% CI 0.821 to 0.877). After calibration, weighted κ was 0.812 (0.766 to 0.844) against 0.791 (0.710 to 0.853) between two examiners, and agreement within one grade was 96.8%. Participant means correlated at r = 0.930, with ICC(2,1) 0.916. Automated buccal plaque coverage from disclosed photographs agreed with the T-QHPI scored by a calibrated examiner, and after threshold calibration the agreement did not differ from that between two examiners. Automated plaque grading from disclosed photographs could serve as an auxiliary tool, a second opinion that supports, rather than replaces, the clinician's plaque scoring, pending external validation.
zh_abstract: [Journal of dentistry] 旨在确定从显示剂染色口内照片自动测量的颊部菌斑覆盖率与由经校准牙医评分的Turesky改良Quigley-Hein菌斑指数（T-QHPI）是否一致。20名成人在48小时不进行口腔卫生后拍摄一张正面和两张侧面视图照片，并由一名对模型不知情的经校准牙医对相同牙齿评分T-QHPI。两个U-Net（ResNet-34）模型（每个视图一个）在参与者水平五折交叉验证下训练，覆盖率为每个勾画出的颊侧牙冠的染色百分比。覆盖率与临床分级通过Spearman's ρ比较，并在按指数定义和校准阈值转换为T-QHPI等级后，通过加权κ比较；参与者均值通过Pearson's r、组内相关系数ICC(2,1)和Bland-Altman分析比较。438颗牙齿与临床分级进行了比较。两个视图中的分割Dice均为0.88。覆盖率对牙齿的排序与临床指数的一致性为ρ = 0.856（95% CI 0.821至0.877）。校准后，加权κ为0.812（0.766至0.844），而两名检查者之间为0.791（0.710至0.853），且相差不超过一个等级的一致性为96.8%。参与者均值的相关性为r = 0.930，ICC(2,1)为0.916。从染色照片自动获得的颊部菌斑覆盖率与经校准检查者评分的T-QHPI一致，且阈值校准后，其一致性程度与两名检查者之间的一致性无差异。从染色照片进行自动菌斑分级可作为辅助工具，即支持而非替代临床医生菌斑评分的第二意见，尚待外部验证。

abstract: [Public health] Examine the "last mile problem" in artificial intelligence (AI) applications for preventive public health. Conceptual short communication introducing a five-stage pathway to examine where AI-enabled prevention breaks down. This draws on emerging literature in AI, health services research, and implementation science to distinguish between predictive capacity and real-world impact. A five-stage pathway model of prediction, translation, delivery, uptake, and sustainment is introduced to characterize where breakdowns occur between identifying risk and changing outcomes. Current AI applications in public health are heavily concentrated in prediction, with limited attention to delivery, engagement, and sustained behavior change. These gaps are particularly consequential in prevention, where action must occur before consequences are visible, and in contexts such as family caregiving, where individuals operate as de facto delivery systems without adequate support. Traditional measures of healthcare access further obscure the problem by suggesting that services are available when real-world barriers prevent their use. The last mile problem is not evenly distributed; it disproportionately affects populations facing structural disadvantage, meaning that AI systems that fail to account for delivery and context risk widening existing inequities. Addressing the last mile requires reorienting AI from a primarily predictive tool to one embedded in systems of care and daily life. This includes integrating real-time data, designing for context, and evaluating AI on whether it enables timely, sustained action, not on predictive accuracy alone. Until AI reaches the last mile, its contribution to prevention will remain incomplete, accurate in prediction but limited in impact.
zh_abstract: 【公共卫生】考察人工智能（AI）在预防性公共卫生应用中的“最后一英里问题”。本概念性简短通讯引入一个五阶段路径，用以考察AI赋能的预防在何处失效。本文借鉴AI、卫生服务研究和实施科学的新兴文献，以区分预测能力与现实世界影响。引入由预测、转化、提供、采纳和维持构成的五阶段路径模型，以刻画在识别风险与改变结局之间何处发生失效。当前公共卫生中的AI应用高度集中于预测，而对提供、参与和持续行为改变的关注有限。这些缺口在预防中尤其重要，因为行动必须在后果显现之前发生；在家庭照护等情境中也是如此，个体在没有充分支持的情况下充当事实上的服务提供系统。传统的医疗保健可及性测量进一步掩盖了该问题，因为当现实障碍阻止服务使用时，这些测量却提示服务可获得。最后一英里问题并非均匀分布；它不成比例地影响面临结构性劣势的人群，这意味着未能考虑提供和情境的AI系统有可能扩大现有不公平。解决最后一英里问题需要将AI从主要作为预测工具重新定位为嵌入照护系统和日常生活的工具。这包括整合实时数据、针对情境进行设计，并评估AI是否能够促成及时、持续的行动，而不仅仅是评估预测准确性。在AI抵达最后一英里之前，其对预防的贡献仍将不完整——预测准确，但影响有限。

title: AI-Empowered Multimodal Data Integration and Knowledge Discovery for Pharmacovigilance

abstract: Biomedical artificial intelligence (AI) increasingly relies on heterogeneous data sources, yet differences in data structure, terminology, evidence quality, and provenance complicate their integration into reliable knowledge resources. Here, we develop an evidence-aware framework for processing and integrating heterogeneous pharmacovigilance data from FDA Adverse Event Reporting System (FAERS) reports, biomedical literature, clinical trials, and electronic health records in Mass General Brigham. The framework combines large language model (LLM)-based information extraction, ontology-driven semantic normalization, cross-source evidence assessment, statistical and machine learning-based prioritization, and ingredient-based adverse drug event (ADE) relationship inference to transform heterogeneous evidence into a structured and evidence-based knowledge resource. The constructed knowledge system contains 11,588 drug nodes, 44,843 ingredient nodes, 3,275 ADE nodes, 993 indication nodes, and more than 2.47 million relationships, with each drug-ADE relationship assigned a confidence score. We further developed a drug-level web interface for accessing the knowledge resource and validated its utility in downstream AI tasks. Specifically, incorporating the developed knowledge resource improved the comprehensiveness, relevance, and overall quality of LLM-based drug-specific ADE synthesis and improved the precision and F1 score of clinical ADE relation extraction. These results demonstrate that AI-assisted processing combined with evidence-aware curation can transform heterogeneous biomedical evidence into reusable, AI-ready knowledge with explicit provenance and evidence strength information. The framework provides a general strategy for integrating heterogeneous biomedical data to support reproducible knowledge construction and downstream biomedical AI applications.
zh_abstract: 生物医学人工智能（AI）日益依赖异质性数据源，但数据结、术语、证据质量和来源方面的差异使其整合为可靠知识资源变得复杂。在此，我们开发了一个证据感知框架，用于处理和整合来自FDA不良事件报告系统（FAERS）报告、生物医学文献、临床试验以及Mass General Brigham电子健康记录的异质性药物警戒数据。该框架结合基于大语言模型（LLM）的信息抽取、本体驱动的语义规范化、跨来源证据评估、基于统计和机器学习的优先级排序，以及基于成分的不良药物事件（ADE）关系推断，将异质性证据转化为结构化且基于证据的知识资源。所构建的知识系统包含11,588个药物节点、44,843个成分节点、3,275个ADE节点、993个适应证节点，以及超过247万条关系，每条药物-ADE关系均被赋予置信度评分。我们进一步开发了药物层面的网页界面以访问该知识资源，并验证其在下游AI任务中的效用。具体而言，纳入所构建的知识资源提高了基于LLM的药物特异性ADE综合的全面性、相关性和整体质量，并提高了临床ADE关系抽取的精确率和F1分数。这些结果表明，AI辅助处理结合证据感知策展可将异质性生物医学证据转化为可重用、AI就绪且具有明确来源和证据强度信息的知识。该框架为整合异质性生物医学数据以支持可重复的知识构建和下游生物医学AI应用提供了通用策略。

title: An Evidence-Driven Multi-Agent Compound AI System for Head and Neck Proton Radiotherapy Planning
