abstract: Radiation treatment planning requires balancing competing objectives to satisfy clinical criteria while accommodating physicians' preferences. This study aims to develop an evidence-driven, multi-agent compound AI system that integrates DRL-based automated treatment planning with LLM-based conversational plan refinement for proton PBS therapy. A policy network trained using PPO first generates multiple plans without human intervention, from which one is selected as the target plan and the others serve as references for subsequent refinements. For challenging cases requiring further adjustments, an LLM-based multi-agent system enables plan refinement through natural language interactions. The system comprises a planning agent that recommends evidence-supported adjustments, a chatbot providing a unified conversational interface, and an evaluation agent that retrieves clinical metrics and identifies constraint violations. To enhance domain-specific reasoning, the planning agent based on Qwen3-14B is designed to justify its recommendations using evidence from previously generated plans and post-trained on task-specific data using SFT and GRPO. The framework was trained and evaluated using 21 patients with H&N cancers, with 5 PPO-generated plans per patient. Of these, 50 plans were selected for instruction-guided refinement. Compared with the base LLM, the post-trained Qwen3-14B demonstrated improved instruction-following, information retrieval and domain-specific reasoning capabilities. The resulting adjustments more effectively improved user-prioritized objectives while limiting deterioration in competing objectives, yielding more clinically appropriate trade-offs in patient-specific plan refinement. The proposed compound AI system provides a user-friendly planning platform, offering a promising approach to personalized proton PBS treatment planning.
zh_abstract: 放射治疗计划需要在满足临床标准的同时平衡相互竞争的目标，并兼顾医生的偏好。本研究旨在开发一个证据驱动的多智能体复合AI系统，将基于深度强化学习（DRL）的自动治疗计划与基于LLM的对话式计划细化相结合，用于质子PBS治疗。首先，使用近端策略优化（PPO）训练的策略网络在无人干预的情况下生成多个计划，从中选择一个作为目标计划，其余作为后续细化的参考。对于需要进一步调整的困难病例，基于LLM的多智能体系统通过自然语言交互实现计划细化。该系统包括一个规划智能体，负责推荐有证据支持的调整；一个聊天机器人，提供统一的对话界面；以及一个评估智能体，负责检索临床指标并识别约束违反。为增强领域特定推理，基于Qwen3-14B的规划智能体被设计为利用先前生成计划中的证据为其建议提供依据，并使用SFT和GRPO在任务特定数据上进行后训练。该框架使用21例头颈部（H&N）癌症患者进行训练和评估，每例患者有5个PPO生成的计划。其中，50个计划被选中用于指令引导的细化。与基础LLM相比，后训练的Qwen3-14B表现出改进的指令遵循、信息检索和领域特定推理能力。由此产生的调整更有效地改善了用户优先考虑的目标，同时限制了竞争目标的恶化，在患者特异性计划细化中产生更符合临床的权衡。所提出的复合AI系统提供了一个用户友好的计划平台，为个性化质子PBS治疗计划提供了一种有前景的方法。

title: GENOAR: Global Engine for Navigating the Omnicell space via Agent-based Research
zh_title: GENOAR：智能体驱动的单细胞数据引擎
summary: 用AI智能体与并行计算处理约5400万个单细胞转录组数据，实现命名、存储与检索。
key_points: 覆盖人鼠约5400万细胞的转录组数据
并行计算加速单细胞数据预处理
AI命名智能体规范化非结构化细胞标签
AI图书馆员智能体负责数据检索
reason: 大规模单细胞资源有潜在价值，但预印本且开放与评测情况不明
abstract: Although generative models have revolutionized many fields, including genomics, building a scalable dataset compatible with artificial intelligence (AI) is essential yet underexplored. Here, we developed a Global Engine for navigating the Omnicell space via Agent-based Research (GENOAR) that covers approximately 54 million cells for diverse downstream tasks using AI agents and parallel computing. GENOAR outperforms in three parts. Parallel computations accelerated the preprocessing of single-cell transcriptomic data; the other components enabled agent-assisted data storage and exploration for both AI models and humans. GENOAR involves two AI agents: an AI nomenclaturist ordered the unstructured labels of the single-cell transcriptomic profiles, and an AI librarian retrieved data. GENOAR presents transcriptomic profiles from more than 54 million cells from humans and mice in an analysis-ready format for humans and AI agents. AI agents in GENOAR exhibited successful retrieval performance compared with human experts. Using GENOAR, we elucidated progenitor cell-associated transcriptional signatures in native retinoblastoma and organoid environments. GENOAR was released and validated for the on-demand construction of single-cell atlases for metazoa. In conclusion, using GENOAR, the development of a single-cell transcriptomic atlas compatible with both AI systems and human researchers is feasible, scalable, and reproducible.
zh_abstract: 尽管生成模型已经革新了许多领域，包括基因组学，但构建一个与人工智能（AI）兼容的可扩展数据集至关重要却仍探索不足。在此，我们开发了一个通过基于智能体的研究在Omnicell空间中导航的全球引擎（GENOAR），其利用AI智能体和并行计算覆盖约5400万个细胞，服务于多样化的下游任务。GENOAR在三个方面表现突出。并行计算加速了单细胞转录组数据的预处理；其他组件则为AI模型和人类实现了智能体辅助的数据存储和探索。GENOAR涉及两个AI智能体：一个AI命名员对单细胞转录组谱的非结构化标签进行整理，一个AI图书管理员检索数据。GENOAR以可供人类和AI智能体分析就绪的格式呈现来自人类和小鼠的超过5400万个细胞的转录组谱。与人类专家相比，GENOAR中的AI智能体表现出成功的检索性能。利用GENOAR，我们阐明了原生视网膜母细胞瘤和类器官环境中与祖细胞相关的转录特征。GENOAR已发布并经过验证，可用于按需构建后生动物单细胞图谱。总之，利用GENOAR，开发一个同时兼容AI系统和人类研究人员的单细胞转录组图谱是可行、可扩展且可重复的。

title: hvantk: an agentic multi-omics framework for variant annotation and analysis
zh_title: hvantk：变异注释与分析的多组学智能体框架
summary: 提出智能体化多组学框架，为大规模遗传变异注释与分析提供统一数据模型，并集成21个公共数据源插件。
key_points: 扩展 Hail MatrixTable 与 AnnData 通用数据格式
以插件方式集成21个公共多组学数据提供方
可由开发者或 AI 智能体编写插件而无需改动核心
reason: 开源框架整合多数据源有新意，但为预印本且缺效果验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Large-scale genetic variant analysis involves multiple computational steps, data formats, gene and variant annotation sources and compute requirements. Some of the steps like joint calling for large cohorts are run on large compute clusters, while gene/variant classification algorithms can be run in a desktop computer. At the same time, variant annotations such as gene expression and gene constraints metrics from gnomAD are provided in different formats, by resources that frequently change their versions. Here, we present hvantk, a framework that provides a common data model for large-scale annotation and analysis of genetic variants, by extending popular data formats such as Hail MatrixTable and AnnData. hvantk agentically integrates 21 public multi-omic data providers as plugins that a developer, bioinformatician or an AI agent can author without modifying the framework's core, drives analysis workflows using agent skills, and scales from single desktop computers to high-performance computing clusters. We used hvantk for reanalysing three case-control cohorts, comprising congenital heart disease (CHD), developmental and epileptic encephalopathy (Epi25) and schizophrenia (SCHEMA). Re-ranking of gene-based burden testing results using multi-omic annotations improved the recovery of curated disease genes from 26% to 49% in CHD, 40% to 48% in Epi25 and 51% to 54% in SCHEMA, among the top decile re-ranked genes. Expression at bulk and single-cell levels were the features contributing the most over a baseline of burden, gene constraint and publication count.
zh_abstract: 大规模遗传变异分析涉及多个计算步骤、数据格式、基因和变异注释来源以及计算需求。一些步骤，如针对大队列的联合变异检测（joint calling），在大型计算集群上运行，而基因/变异分类算法可以在台式计算机上运行。与此同时，变异注释（例如来自gnomAD的基因表达和基因约束指标）由频繁更改版本的资源以不同格式提供。在此，我们提出hvantk，一个通过扩展Hail MatrixTable和AnnData等流行数据格式，为大规模遗传变异注释和分析提供通用数据模型的框架。hvantk以智能体方式将21个公共多组学数据提供者集成为插件，开发者、生物信息学家或AI智能体无需修改框架核心即可编写这些插件；它使用智能体技能驱动分析工作流，并可从单台台式计算机扩展到高性能计算集群。我们使用hvantk重新分析三个病例对照队列，包括先天性心脏病（CHD）、发育性和癫痫性脑病（Epi25）以及精神分裂症（SCHEMA）。使用多组学注释对基于基因的负荷检验结果重新排序，在重新排序后的前十分位基因中，对经人工整理疾病基因的召回率从CHD的26%提高到49%，Epi25的40%提高到48%，SCHEMA的51%提高到54%。在负荷、基因约束和发表数量基线之上，bulk和单细胞水平的表达是贡献最大的特征。

title: Implicit reconstruction of gating strategies from sample-level flow cytometry annotations
zh_title: 从样本级流式注释隐式重建门控策略
summary: 预印本提出弱监督多示例框架IMPGAT，仅用样本级细胞频率分布重建单细胞门控策略。
key_points: 无需单细胞级标签或无监督聚类
采用诱导集合注意力映射标志物谱
在急性淋巴细胞白血病等数据上评估
reason: 有新意的弱监督预印本方法，证据限于预印本评估，值得一看档。
abstract: Flow cytometry is central to clinical hematology, generating extensive archives comprising billions of single-cell profiles linked to expert-derived diagnostic summaries. While these records represent a largely untapped repository of collective expert knowledge, the underlying single-cell annotations required for supervised machine learning are typically not recorded in a standardized, accessible format. We present IMPGAT (implicit gating), a weakly supervised multiple-instance learning framework that reconstructs single-cell gating strategies directly from existing sample-level cell-type frequency distributions. The model utilizes an induced set attention mechanism to map single-cell marker profiles to specific cell populations, requiring neither explicit cell-level labels nor unsupervised clustering during training. We evaluate the framework on acute lymphoblastic leukemia (ALL) and acute myeloid leukemia (AML) cohorts, totaling 711 measurements from 268 individuals and 240 million single cells. In ALL, the model's quantification of cell-type abundances shows no statistically significant difference from human inter-expert variability. In AML, the framework achieves blast quantification on par with a recently established supervised state-of-the-art model that relies on explicit single-cell annotations for training. Error analysis shows that mismatches between model predictions and expert gating primarily involve expert-labeled non-cellular events, reflecting the non-incorporation of any explicit physical prior knowledge (such as the geometric relationships traditionally used to identify doublets and debris in scatter cytograms) in model training. Conversely, model certainty correlates with phenotypic borderline cases where manual bisection is inherently difficult. Our approach enables the systematic utilization of retrospective clinical records for the development of automated, standardized gating logic and is applicable to broader high-throughput contexts, such as large-scale immune monitoring or phenotypic drug screening.
zh_abstract: 流式细胞术是临床血液学的核心，产生了大量档案，包含数十亿个单细胞图谱，并与专家得出的诊断摘要相关联。虽然这些记录在很大程度上是一个尚未被充分利用的集体专家知识库，但监督式机器学习所需的底层单细胞注释通常未以标准化、可访问的格式记录。我们提出IMPGAT（implicit gating，隐式门控），一种弱监督多实例学习框架，可直接从现有样本水平的细胞类型频率分布重建单细胞门控策略。该模型利用诱导集合注意力机制将单细胞标志物图谱映射到特定细胞群体，在训练期间既不需要明确的细胞水平标签，也不需要无监督聚类。我们在急性淋巴细胞白血病（ALL）和急性髓系白血病（AML）队列上评估该框架，总计来自268名个体的711次测量和2.4亿个单细胞。在ALL中，该模型对细胞类型丰度的量化与人类专家间变异性相比无统计学显著差异。在AML中，该框架实现的原始细胞量化与最近建立的、依赖明确单细胞注释进行训练的监督式最先进模型相当。误差分析显示，模型预测与专家门控之间的不匹配主要涉及专家标记的非细胞事件，这反映了模型训练中未纳入任何明确的物理先验知识（例如传统上用于识别散点细胞图中双联体和碎片的几何关系）。相反，模型确定性与小表型临界病例相关，这些病例本质上难以人工二分。我们的方法能够系统性地利用回顾性临床记录来开发自动化、标准化的门控逻辑，并适用于更广泛的高通量场景，例如大规模免疫监测或表型药物筛选。

title: Decision language models as affordable and rapid alternatives to LLM judges of clinical generative AI
zh_title: 决策语言模型作为临床生成式AI的低成本评判者
summary: 预印本比较结构化输出的决策语言模型Jev与多家LLM评判者，在四个场景中与医师评分一致性相当或更优。
key_points: 儿科118份回答上与医师序数评分一致性0.50
部分指标达到或超过前沿LLM评判者
前沿评判者成本更高，Jev更廉价快速
reason: 评测方法有新意但为预印本、样本有限，值得一看档。
abstract: Automated judges of clinical artificial intelligence (AI) outputs are necessary, but large language model (LLM) judges are costly and slow at scale. We compared Jev, a decision language model that returns structured judgments, with frontier and open-weight LLM judges in four use cases. On 118 pediatric answers, Jev's agreement with physicians' ordinal quality ratings (Gwet's AC2 0.50; expected score 0.53) matched or exceeded that of seven of 12 LLM judges, including frontier models, Claude Opus 5.5 (0.49) and GPT-6 (0.38). On physician-graded binary HealthBench criteria, Jev matched or exceeded four of six LLM judges. On MedHELM's open-ended tasks, Jev's agreement with a three-LLM jury approached or exceeded the jurors' internal agreement. On HealthBench Professional, Jev matched the benchmark's reference judge, GPT-5.4, on 91% of criteria (other judges, 91-93%). Frontier judges cost 73-294 times more than Jev and took 7-57 times longer. Jev may enable efficient clinical AI evaluation at scale.
zh_abstract: 对临床人工智能（AI）输出进行自动评判是必要的，但大语言模型（LLM）评判器在大规模应用时成本高且速度慢。我们在四个用例中将Jev（一种返回结构化判断的决策语言模型）与前沿及开放权重LLM评判器进行比较。在118个儿科答案上，Jev与医生序数质量评分的一致性（Gwet's AC2 0.50；期望分数0.53）达到或超过12个LLM评判器中的7个，包括前沿模型Claude Opus 5.5（0.49）和GPT-6（0.38）。在由医生评分的二元HealthBench标准上，Jev达到或超过6个LLM评判器中的4个。在MedHELM的开放式任务上，Jev与三个LLM组成的评审团的一致性接近或超过评审团内部一致性。在HealthBench Professional上，Jev在91%的标准上与基准参考评判器GPT-5.4一致（其他评判器为91-93%）。前沿评判器的成本是Jev的73-294倍，耗时是Jev的7-57倍。Jev可能实现高效的规模化临床AI评估。

title: A Review of Suicide-Related Risks through Propensity Score Methods using the Maryland Suicide Data Warehouse
zh_title: 基于倾向评分方法的自杀风险因素分析
summary: medRxiv预印本利用马里兰自杀数据仓库约百万条记录，以倾向评分方法评估自杀风险因素。
key_points: 混合自杀死亡者与在世患者共约100万条记录
纳入人口学、精神疾病、物质使用与社会需求因素
比较四种方法控制多变量混杂，评估因素效应一致性
reason: 大样本预印本方法研究，未提及外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Objective A diversity of approaches and cohorts have been published in research literature for suicide risk estimation, leading to some uncertainty around which factors and conditions are most strongly contributing to risk. Methods exist for weighting estimates by propensity score, removing simplifying the interpretation of model effects. Few studies have explored the use of these tools to assess when the effect of certain factors is uncertain or inconsistent. Method A mix of 1,001,737 suicide decedents and living patients were evaluated for suicide risk, relying on a subset of commonly identified factors: demographics, psychiatric conditions, substance use disorders, and social needs. Care utilization patterns were then assessed controlling for these factors in a hospital care setting. Four methods were considered for controlling multivariate confounding of odds predicting death by suicide: multivariate logistic regression, 1-to-1 sample matching, inverse propensity weighting (IPTW), and entropy balancing (EBAL). Results Test statistics showed suicide decedents were much more likely to have various psychiatric and substance use diagnoses, social needs and more likely to heightened care utilization across sampling intervals. Greater utilization was found close to date of death. Effect sizes after IPTW and EBAL weighting were also generally greater than would have been documented by regression alone. Conclusions Propensity weighting is a useful alternative to exploring nuanced effects, especially when the direction and strength of an association differ from traditional statistics. By weighting, the overall imbalance of cases remains consistent and effect terms might reflect more nuanced associations than regression or sample matching alone.
zh_abstract: 【目的】研究文献中已发表多种用于自杀风险评估的方法和队列，这导致对于哪些因素和状况对风险的贡献最强存在一定不确定性。已有方法可通过倾向评分对估计值进行加权，从而简化模型效应的解释。很少有研究探讨使用这些工具来评估某些因素的影响何时不确定或不一致。【方法】对 1,001,737 名自杀死亡者和在世患者组成的混合人群进行了自杀风险评估，依据一组常见识别因素中的子集：人口学特征、精神疾病、物质使用障碍和社会需求。随后在医院照护环境中控制这些因素，评估照护利用模式。考虑了四种方法控制预测自杀死亡的优势比的多变量混杂：多变量 logistic 回归、1:1 样本匹配、逆倾向加权（IPTW）和熵平衡（EBAL）。【结果】检验统计量显示，自杀死亡者更可能患有多种精神疾病和物质使用诊断、存在社会需求，并且在各个采样区间更可能出现照护利用增加。在接近死亡日期时发现照护利用更高。经 IPTW 和 EBAL 加权后的效应量通常也大于仅用回归所记录的效应量。【结论】倾向加权是探索细微效应的有用替代方法，尤其是当关联的方向和强度与传统统计结果不同时。通过加权，病例的总体不平衡保持一致，效应项可能比仅用回归或样本匹配更能反映细微的关联。

title: LoCoFlow: Local-Context Flow Matching for Single-Cell Dynamics and Fate Inference
zh_title: LoCoFlow：单细胞动力学的局部上下文流匹配
summary: 预印本提出 LoCoFlow 流匹配框架，结合局部点云几何与命运不确定性推断单细胞动力学。
key_points: 用重叠斑块构建群体间分层传输
端点保留神经桥正则化斑块内运动
可采样替代的细胞命运轨迹
reason: 新方法预印本，建模思路清晰但无外部验证，属值得一看档。
abstract: Single-cell sequencing profiles cellular states at discrete time points, providing population-level snapshots from which developmental and disease-associated trajectories can be reconstructed. Existing optimal-transport and flow-matching approaches typically infer temporal couplings at the level of individual cells, with limited representation of the local manifold geometry of cell-state space and the uncertainty inherent in lineage diversification. We introduce LoCoFlow, a flow-matching framework that combines local point-cloud geometry with conditional fate uncertainty. Overlapping patches define hierarchical transport between populations, and an endpoint-preserving neural bridge regularizes motion and deformation within these patches. Bridge velocities supervise a conditional field with patch-shared and cell-specific latent variables, from which alternative trajectories can be sampled without future observations. Temporal and spatial benchmarks show improvements in transport distance. On lineage-traced LARRY data, LoCoFlow reduces mean raw Brier error from 0.7990 to 0.6620 relative to scDiffEq at the same number of endpoint draws. Expression perturbations further reveal distinct roles for focal-cell and neighborhood information: geometric-patch models show aligned background and whole-patch responses, whereas random-minibatch models show opposing focal and background responses. These findings support local context as a useful representation for probabilistic fate inference and provide testable hypotheses about how it shapes predicted responses.
zh_abstract: 单细胞测序在离散时间点刻画细胞状态，提供群体水平的快照，从中可以重建发育和疾病相关轨迹。现有的最优传输和流匹配方法通常在单个细胞水平推断时间耦合，对细胞状态空间的局部流形几何以及谱系多样化所固有的不确定性表征有限。我们提出 LoCoFlow，一种将局部点云几何与条件命运不确定性相结合的流匹配框架。重叠的 patch 定义群体之间的分层传输，而保持端点的神经桥则正则化这些 patch 内的运动和变形。桥速度监督一个条件场，该场具有 patch 共享和细胞特异性潜变量，由此可以在没有未来观测的情况下采样替代轨迹。时间和空间基准显示传输距离有所改善。在谱系追踪的 LARRY 数据上，在相同终点采样次数下，LoCoFlow 相对于 scDiffEq 将平均原始 Brier 误差从 0.7990 降至 0.6620。表达扰动进一步揭示了焦点细胞和邻域信息的不同作用：几何 patch 模型显示对齐的背景和全 patch 响应，而随机小批量模型显示相反的焦点和背景响应。这些发现支持局部背景作为概率命运推断的有用表示，并提供了关于它如何塑造预测响应的可检验假设。

title: Block Diffusion for Longitudinal EHR: Accuracy, Efficiency, and Representation Trade-offs
zh_title: 面向纵向电子病历的块扩散模型
summary: 预印本在 MIMIC-IV 比较块掩码扩散与自回归模型，报告准确率、效率与表征权衡。
key_points: 匹配分词、上下文与容量等条件比较
B=8 配置推理约快 1.43 倍
线性探针在临床预测任务上性能接近
reason: 预印本方法对比充分但仅 MIMIC-IV 内部评估，属值得一看档。
abstract: Autoregressive (AR) models have proved effective for zero-shot prediction from longitudinal electronic health records, but impose strictly sequential generation on trajectories containing temporally clustered and interdependent clinical events. We investigate block-based masked diffusion (BD) as an alternative on MIMIC-IV under matched tokenisation, context length, model capacity, and evaluation conditions. Across block sizes, BD exhibits a clear quality--efficiency trade-off, with small-block configurations retaining much of the predictive performance of AR while enabling substantially faster inference. A representative $B{=}8$ configuration achieves approximately $1.43\times$ faster evaluation. Although generative rollout remains below AR in most settings, frozen linear probes on BD and AR representations achieve near-identical performance across clinical prediction tasks, indicating that BD learns comparably informative clinical representations. Increasing the denoising budget yields diminishing returns, while alternative decoding strategies provide limited gains. Overall, our results show that block diffusion is a viable and computationally attractive approach to longitudinal EHR modelling, with further improvements in iterative decoding offering a promising route toward closing the remaining generative performance gap.
zh_abstract: 自回归（AR）模型已被证明可有效用于纵向电子健康记录的零样本预测，但对包含时间聚集且相互依存的临床事件的轨迹施加严格的顺序生成。我们在 MIMIC-IV 上，在匹配的分词、上下文长度、模型容量和评估条件下，研究基于块的掩码扩散（BD）作为替代方案。跨块大小，BD 表现出明显的质量-效率权衡，小块配置保留了 AR 的大部分预测性能，同时实现显著更快的推理。一个代表性的 $B{=}8$ 配置实现约 $1.43\times$ 更快的评估。尽管在大多数设置中生成式推演仍低于 AR，但对 BD 和 AR 表示进行冻结线性探针在临床预测任务上取得几乎相同的性能，表明 BD 学习到信息量相当的临床表示。增加去噪预算产生递减回报，而替代解码策略提供有限增益。总体而言，我们的结果表明，块扩散是纵向 EHR 建模的一种可行且具有计算吸引力的方法，迭代解码的进一步改进为缩小剩余生成性能差距提供了有希望的途径。

title: Are Joint-Embedding Predictive Objectives Effective for Longitudinal EHRs?
zh_title: JEPA预训练目标适用于纵向电子病历吗
summary: arXiv预印本在MIMIC-IV上比较三种JEPA与掩码语言建模，发现JEPA可稳定训练但性能持续低于MLM。
key_points: MIMIC-IV上比较JEPA与MLM预训练
三种JEPA均无表征坍缩但性能落后
目标尺寸而非异质性抬高预测误差
reason: 预印本阴性结果，MIMIC-IV实证有参考价值，但无外部验证，属值得一看档。
abstract: Masked language modelling (MLM) is the dominant pretraining objective for transformer encoders applied to longitudinal electronic health records (EHRs). However, reconstructing individual events may overemphasise noisy or weakly informative observations and does not explicitly encourage learning higher-level patient states. Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) instead learn by predicting representations in latent space and have shown strong performance in a variety of domains. In this paper, we investigate to what extent JEPA can be adapted to EHR sequence representation. Our empirical investigation using MIMIC-IV shows that although all three of our JEPA formulations train stably without representational collapse, they consistently underperform standard MLM. We find that target size, not target heterogeneity, increases prediction error, yet reducing the target size does not recover downstream performance. This suggests that stable latent prediction alone is insufficient for competitive EHR representation learning and highlights the challenge of defining clinically meaningful latent targets for EHR.
zh_abstract: 掩码语言建模（MLM）是应用于纵向电子健康记录（EHR）的 transformer 编码器的主流预训练目标。然而，重建单个事件可能过度强调噪声或信息量弱的观察，并且不明确鼓励学习更高层次的患者状态。联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）则通过在潜在空间中预测表征来学习，并已在多个领域显示出强劲性能。本文研究 JEPA 在多大程度上可适配于 EHR 序列表征。我们使用 MIMIC-IV 的实证研究表明，尽管我们的三种 JEPA 表述均能稳定训练且不发生表征坍缩，但它们的表现始终逊于标准 MLM。我们发现，增大目标大小而非目标异质性会增加预测误差，然而减小目标大小并不能恢复下游性能。这表明，仅稳定的潜在预测不足以实现有竞争力的 EHR 表征学习，并凸显了为 EHR 定义临床上有意义的潜在目标的挑战。

title: Reading the Mask: Descriptor-Grounded BI-RADS Rationale Generation for Breast MRI Segmentation
zh_title: 面向乳腺MRI分割的BI-RADS依据生成
summary: arXiv预印本从分割掩膜提取BI-RADS定量描述符，并用大语言模型生成可解释的自然语言依据。
key_points: 以BI-RADS决策树定义8个节点描述符
由分割掩膜与强化序列计算影像组学特征
用LLM生成受限于描述符的语言依据
reason: 预印本新方法结合影像组学与LLM提升可解释性，证据限于自身数据，属值得一看档。
abstract: Deep learning based models accurately delineate tumours on dynamic contrast-enhanced MRI (DCE-MRI), but segmentation masks alone do not provide the rationales or reasoning used by radiologists to assess the lesion suspicion. This limits the explainability as well the clinical integration. We investigate whether clinically relevant descriptors can instead be derived from the segmentation masks and their dynamic contrast-enhancement series. We have used Breast Imaging Reporting and Data System (BI-RADS) guidelines as a structured framework. Using these guidelines we designed a BI-RADS decision tree with eight quantitative measurements using radiomics, together with the lesion size and component count, that determine the descriptors at eight nodes. Using these descriptors we generate natural-language rationale using a large language model. The model was constrained to express only the derived records from the decision tree. After applying this framework to the expert and automatic masks of each of the 1,506 cases in the MAMA-MIA dataset, we generated a reproducible corpus of 3,012 BI-RADS grounded rationales. We obtained a faithfulness score of 99.98% and a counterfactual accuracy of 99.3%, indicating that the generated rationales faithfully verbalises the measured descriptors and correctly reflects changes in the underlying record. Agreement between the descriptors from expert and automatic masks falls from 0.832 to 0.549 as mask quality falls from Good to Missed. The generated rationales are intended as draft representations for radiologist review and final sign-off rather than autonomous clinical reports.
zh_abstract: 基于深度学习的模型能够在动态对比增强MRI（DCE-MRI）上准确勾画肿瘤，但仅凭分割掩膜并不能提供放射科医生评估病变可疑性时所用的依据或推理。这限制了可解释性以及临床整合。我们研究是否可改为从分割掩膜及其动态对比增强序列中推导出临床相关描述符。我们使用乳腺影像报告和数据系统（BI-RADS）指南作为结构化框架。利用这些指南，我们设计了一个BI-RADS决策树，包含八项使用影像组学的定量测量，连同病灶大小和成分计数，在八个节点上确定描述符。利用这些描述符，我们使用大语言模型生成自然语言依据。该模型被约束为仅表达来自决策树的推导记录。将该框架应用于MAMA-MIA数据集中1,506例每例的专家掩膜和自动掩膜后，我们生成了包含3,012条以BI-RADS为依据的理由的可重复语料库。我们获得99.98%的忠实性评分和99.3%的反事实准确率，表明生成的依据忠实表述了所测量的描述符，并正确反映了底层记录的变化。随着掩膜质量从Good降至Missed，专家掩膜与自动掩膜所得描述符之间的一致性从0.832降至0.549。生成的依据旨在作为供放射科医生审阅并最终签核的草稿性表述，而非自主临床报告。

title: G-ALN: a GPU-accelerated BWA-aln algorithm for palaeogenomics
zh_title: GPU加速古DNA比对的G-ALN算法
summary: G-ALN用GPU实现BWA-aln与索引算法，输出与BWA逐字节一致并显著加速。
key_points: GPU实现BWA-aln与索引算法
输出与BWA逐字节一致
索引约快32倍，比对约快6倍
reason: 预印本工具，基准显示明显加速且输出一致，属值得一看档。
abstract: Abstract Summary: The most commonly used method to achieve optimal mapping for short and damaged ancient DNA (aDNA) reads is the BWA-aln algorithm with seeding disabled. However, this CPU-based algorithm is computationally demanding, as the aligner must tolerate mismatches and indels across the entire read. To improve alignment speed, we present G-ALN: a GPU implementation of the BWA-aln and indexing algorithms. G-ALN first searches all reads on GPU cores, with reads that need a long search being shared dynamically between the GPU and any spare CPU cores. Every read is searched using the same algorithm as BWA, so the output is byte-identical, which we confirmed here using woolly mammoth and Neanderthal datasets with aDNA-specific parameters. In our benchmarking, G-ALN indexed a reference genome ~32 times faster than BWA, and read alignment speed increased ~6-fold. G-ALN was developed through AI-assisted coding (Claude Opus 5.5). It processes thousands of reads in parallel on each GPU and aligns more than twice as many aDNA reads per unit of energy. These results show that G-ALN offers a practical route to using GPU resources in established aDNA analysis workflows. Availability and Implementation: G-ALN is implemented in C++ and CUDA and is freely available under the GPLv3 license at https://github.com/bilalbioinfo/galn. It requires an NVIDIA GPU with compute capability 7.0 or higher and CUDA 11.8 or later.
zh_abstract: 【摘要】实现短小且受损的古DNA（aDNA）读段最优比对的最常用方法是禁用种子（seeding）的BWA-aln算法。然而，这种基于CPU的算法计算需求很高，因为比对器必须在整条读段上容忍错配和插入缺失。为提高比对速度，我们提出G-ALN：BWA-aln和索引算法的GPU实现。G-ALN首先在GPU核心上搜索所有读段，需要长时间搜索的读段在GPU和任何空闲CPU核心之间动态共享。每条读段均使用与BWA相同的算法搜索，因此输出字节完全一致，我们在此使用猛犸象和尼安德特人数据集及aDNA特异性参数予以确认。在我们的基准测试中，G-ALN建立参考基因组索引的速度比BWA快约32倍，读段比对速度提高约6倍。G-ALN通过AI辅助编码（Claude Opus 5.5）开发。它在每块GPU上并行处理数千条读段，并且每单位能量可比对超过两倍的aDNA读段。这些结果表明，G-ALN为在现有aDNA分析工作流程中使用GPU资源提供了一条实用途径。【可用性与实现】G-ALN用C++和CUDA实现，并在GPLv3许可证下免费提供，网址为https://github.com/bilalbioinfo/galn。它需要计算能力7.0或更高的NVIDIA GPU以及CUDA 11.8或更高版本。

title: ReSeg: Retraining-free segmentation of abdominal organs via generalizable semantic representation learning
zh_title: ReSeg：免重训练的可泛化腹部器官分割
summary: 预印本提出两阶段免重训练框架，用域随机化合成图像预训练实现跨未见真实域的零样本腹部器官分割。
key_points: 针对现有方法泛化差、需数据集微调的问题
采用语义与视觉多样的合成图像做器官无关预训练
目标为域无关的零样本腹部器官分割
reason: 预印本新方法思路清晰，但条目未体现外部验证与开源，值得一看档
abstract: Abdominal organ segmentation is essential in modern medical applications. While existing deep learning approaches demonstrate promising performance, their heavy reliance on large-scale image data raises concerns over generalization capability and privacy risks. This motivates the development of generalizable segmentation training paradigms based on domain-randomized image synthesis, facilitating generalization across unseen real image domains. However, existing paradigms either suffer from limited segmentation performance when applied to abdominal organs, or require dataset-specific finetuning. To address these limitations, we propose ReSeg, a novel two-stage retraining-free framework for domain-agnostic zero-shot abdominal organ segmentation. At the first stage, our organ-agnostic synthetic data-driven pretraining approach exploits semantically and visually diverse synthetic images generated by a dedicated data engine to optimize a Generalizable Semantic Representation Network (GSRNet). The network is thereby capable of learning semantic features robust against variations in anatomical structure, imaging contrast, resolution and spatial context, which provide universal representation capabilities that serve as a foundation for segmentation learning. Subsequently, in the second stage, we continue to train an Organ-specific Encoder-decoder Segmentation Network (OESNet), whose encoder is initialized with the pretrained weights. This training process is facilitated by another dedicated data engine, which generates diversified visual images while strictly retaining the inherent spatial layout of abdominal organs. Comprehensive evaluation on seven abdominal organ segmentation datasets across three different modalities including CT, MRI, and PET demonstrates that ReSeg consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods while eliminating the need for real training images.
zh_abstract: 腹部器官分割在现代医学应用中至关重要。现有深度学习方法虽表现出良好性能，但其对大规模图像数据的严重依赖引发了对泛化能力和隐私风险的担忧。这促使开发基于域随机化图像合成的可泛化分割训练范式，以促进对未见真实图像域的泛化。然而，现有范式在应用于腹部器官时要么分割性能有限，要么需要针对特定数据集进行微调。为解决这些局限，我们提出ReSeg，一种新颖的两阶段、无需重新训练、面向域无关零样本腹部器官分割的框架。在第一阶段，我们的器官无关合成数据驱动预训练方法利用由专用数据引擎生成的语义和视觉上多样的合成图像来优化可泛化语义表征网络（Generalizable Semantic Representation Network，GSRNet）。该网络因而能够学习对解剖结构、成像对比度、分辨率和空间上下文变化稳健的语义特征，这些特征提供通用表征能力，为分割学习奠定基础。随后，在第二阶段，我们继续训练器官特异性编码器-解码器分割网络（Organ-specific Encoder-decoder Segmentation Network，OESNet），其编码器用预训练权重初始化。该训练过程由另一个专用数据引擎促进，该引擎生成多样化视觉图像，同时严格保留腹部器官的固有空间布局。在涵盖CT、MRI和PET三种不同模态的七个腹部器官分割数据集上进行全面评估表明，ReSeg始终优于现有最先进（SOTA）方法，同时无需真实训练图像。

title: ECG for laboratory values:A comprehensive physiological and technical analysis
zh_title: ECG预测实验室指标：生理与技术分析
summary: 基于MIMIC-IV的多模态深度学习从ECG及患者元数据预测NT-proBNP等实验室值，并比较单导联与12导联。
key_points: 使用MIMIC-IV做回归与分类实验
12导联配置表现一致更好
附录扩展到血糖、血红蛋白、血钾
reason: 预印本且回顾性单库分析，有新方法但缺外部验证
abstract: Laboratory measurements are essential for clinical decision making but typically require invasive blood sampling. Recent research suggests that ECG recordings may contain information beyond cardiac rhythm and provide information related to laboratory values. This thesis investigates NT-proBNP prediction from ECG recordings and patient metadata using a multimodal deep learning framework, while considering the physiological plausibility of ECG-based prediction. It also compares a 1-lead configuration using lead II with the corresponding 12-lead configuration. Additional experiments on glucose, hemoglobin, and potassium are presented in the appendix. Regression, binary classification, and three-class classification experiments were conducted using MIMIC-IV, with the three-class task based on clinically established thresholds. The 12-lead configuration consistently achieved better performance. Regression reached a mean absolute error of 534.98 pg/mL for 1-lead and 514.27 pg/mL for 12-lead. Binary classification achieved AUROCs of 0.849 and 0.876, respectively, while three-class classification achieved macro-averaged AUROCs of 0.738 and 0.752. The results indicate that precise NT-proBNP regression remains challenging, whereas broader concentration ranges can be classified more effectively. The findings are consistent with the physiological hypothesis that ECG characteristics and NT-proBNP concentrations reflect shared cardiovascular processes. ECG-based NT-proBNP prediction may therefore provide complementary information, particularly for classifying broader concentration ranges. However, laboratory measurements remain necessary, and validation on independent datasets is required.
zh_abstract: 实验室检测对临床决策至关重要，但通常需要侵入性采血。近期研究表明，心电图（ECG）记录可能包含心律之外的信息，并提供与实验室检测值相关的信息。本论文研究使用多模态深度学习框架从ECG记录和患者元数据预测NT-proBNP，同时考虑基于ECG预测的生理合理性。它还将使用II导联的1导联配置与相应的12导联配置进行比较。附录中提供了关于葡萄糖、血红蛋白和钾的额外实验。使用MIMIC-IV进行了回归、二分类和三分类实验，其中三分类任务基于临床既定阈值。12导联配置始终取得更好的性能。回归在1导联下达到平均绝对误差534.98 pg/mL，在12导联下为514.27 pg/mL。二分类分别达到AUROC 0.849和0.876，而三分类达到宏平均AUROC 0.738和0.752。结果表明，精确的NT-proBNP回归仍具挑战性，而较宽的浓度范围可以更有效地分类。这些发现与以下生理学假设一致：ECG特征和NT-proBNP浓度反映共同的心血管过程。因此，基于ECG的NT-proBNP预测可能提供补充信息，特别是在对较宽浓度范围进行分类时。然而，实验室检测仍然必要，并且需要在独立数据集上进行验证。

title: Two for One: Privileged Learning for Resource-Constrained Screening
zh_title: 特权学习：仅单眼图像的眼底筛查
summary: 预印本提出特权学习框架，训练时用双眼彩色眼底图教师模型，推理时仅需单眼图像。
key_points: 教师模型训练时获取双眼互补信息
学生模型测试时只输入单眼图像
面向双侧成像不可行时的筛查场景
reason: 方法有新意的预印本，摘要未给出对照与外部验证细节
abstract: Machine learning systems are often developed under data-rich conditions but deployed when only incomplete information is available. A natural example arises in colour fundus photography (CFP), where both eyes are commonly imaged because they can provide complementary information for ocular disease assessment. Prior approaches that exploit bilateral information either fuse both eyes in a single model or use knowledge distillation to compress a dual-eye teacher into a lightweight student that still requires both images at test time. However, bilateral acquisition may not always be feasible. We thus propose a privileged learning framework in which a teacher model has access to bilateral CFP images during training and learns representations informed by information from both eyes, while the student is trained to transfer this knowledge from the bilateral teacher using only a single-eye image as input. At inference, the student operates exclusively on this single-eye input and does not require the contralateral image. Experimental results show consistent improvements in area under the receiver operating characteristic curve over conventional monocular training, with the largest gains observed for left-eye images for the detection of age-related macular degeneration (0.931 vs. 0.966) and diabetic retinopathy (0.789 vs. 0.836).%, while requiring only a single-eye image at inference. By enabling models to benefit from bilateral information during training while requiring only a single-eye image at inference, our approach may support more reliable deployment in resource-constrained clinical and screening environments.
zh_abstract: 机器学习系统常在数据丰富的条件下开发，却在仅有不完整信息可用时部署。一个自然的例子出现在彩色眼底摄影（CFP）中，通常对双眼成像，因为它们可为眼病评估提供互补信息。先前利用双侧信息的方法要么在单一模型中融合双眼，要么使用知识蒸馏将双眼教师压缩为轻量学生模型，而后者在测试时仍需要两张图像。然而，双侧采集并不总是可行。因此，我们提出一种特权学习框架，其中教师模型在训练期间可访问双侧CFP图像，并学习由双眼信息所告知的表征，而学生模型则被训练为仅以单眼图像作为输入，从双侧教师迁移该知识。推理时，学生模型仅在该单眼输入上运行，不需要对侧图像。实验结果显示，与常规单眼训练相比，受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）有一致改善，最大增益出现在左眼图像用于检测年龄相关性黄斑变性（0.931 vs. 0.966）和糖尿病视网膜病变（0.789 vs. 0.836）。在推理时仅需单眼图像。通过使模型在训练期间受益于双侧信息，同时在推理时仅需单眼图像，我们的方法可能支持在资源受限的临床和筛查环境中更可靠地部署。

title: StochIKM: Automated High-Fidelity Reconstruction of Individual Patient Data from Published Kaplan-Meier Curves
zh_title: StochIKM：从KM曲线重建个体患者数据
summary: 预印本提出随机算法，用视觉语言模型数字化Kaplan-Meier曲线并按高保真约束重建个体数据。
key_points: 显式定义高保真：复现风险表与曲线
满足中位生存、区间与事件数约束
返回一组可接受的个体患者数据集
reason: 方法新颖且定义明确，但为预印本、缺独立验证
abstract: Individual patient data are the gold standard for secondary analysis of time-to-event evidence, but they are rarely released, and reconstruction from a published Kaplan-Meier figure could help. Existing methods all claim high fidelity, each judged by whichever agreements it happens to achieve, and each returns a single dataset although the map from figure to data is not bijective. We define fidelity explicitly: a dataset is admissible when it reproduces the risk table exactly, follows the digitized curve to within the image resolution, and respects the printed median, interval and event count. We propose StochIKM, a stochastic algorithm that digitizes the figure with a vision-capable language model and uses the high-fidelity definition as constraints, returning an admissible set of individual patient datasets. A solution is guaranteed to exist whenever the figure has been read correctly, so a failure indicts either the published figure or its digitization. In simulation and in 79 arms from published oncology trials, StochIKM reproduces the published risk tables and medians more closely than LLM-improved IPDfromKM, a high-impact alternative.
zh_abstract: 个体患者数据是时间-事件证据二次分析的金标准，但很少被发布，而从已发表的 Kaplan-Meier 图重建可能有帮助。现有方法均声称高保真，各自以碰巧达到的一致性来评判，并且尽管从图到数据的映射不是双射，每种方法都返回单一数据集。我们明确定义保真度：当数据集精确复现风险表、在图像分辨率范围内遵循数字化曲线，并符合印刷的中位数、区间和事件数时，该数据集是合格的（admissible）。我们提出 StochIKM，一种随机算法，使用具备视觉能力的语言模型对图进行数字化，并将高保真定义作为约束，返回一组合格的个体患者数据集。只要图被正确读取，就保证解存在，因此失败表明要么已发表的图有问题，要么其数字化有问题。在模拟以及来自已发表肿瘤学试验的 79 个臂中，StochIKM 比 LLM 改进的 IPDfromKM（一种高影响力替代方法）更接近地复现已发表的风险表和中位数。

title: Unit-Aware Differentially Private Quantum Machine Learning for Clinical and Wearable Health Data
zh_title: 面向临床与可穿戴数据的单位感知差分隐私量子机器学习
summary: 在三个临床队列与一个可穿戴队列上，比较参数量匹配的量子模型、多层感知机与逻辑回归在差分隐私下的效用。
key_points: 以每条记录或每位参与者为隐私单元
比较量子变分电路与经典模型
关注少样本健康队列的隐私—效用权衡
reason: 多队列基准对比的新颖预印本方法，证据有限，属值得一看档
abstract: Clinical registries and wearable sensors support early health-risk assessment, yet models trained on these records may leak sensitive information when released. Differential privacy (DP) bounds this leakage by injecting noise whose total magnitude grows with the number of trainable parameters, a cost especially severe for small health cohorts. This motivates parameter efficient models including quantum machine learning (QML), whose variational circuits can represent complex decision boundaries with few trainable parameters. It raises a question: at matched input dimensionality and privacy budget, does a quantum model retain more utility than a classical one? We investigate this question on three clinical cohorts and one wearable cohort, treating each clinical record or participant as a privacy unit. We compare capacity-matched quantum, multilayer perceptron, and logistic regression models across five privacy budgets and five seeds. The quantum model leads on three clinical cohorts by up to 0.104 ROC AUC averaged across budgets; however, trails on the wearable cohort, where the small number of participants requires substantial noise. No difference survives Holm correction across 24 tests, so these results indicate a trend rather than a quantum advantage. An analytic gradient bound shows that lower clipping thresholds can improve utility by reducing noise despite clipping bias. Finally, an experiment on IBM quantum computer (ibm_fez, a 156-qubit superconducting processor) using eight fixed test cases yields mean absolute probability errors of 0.046 (private) and 0.063 (non-private) relative to simulation, supporting the feasibility of inference on noisy intermediate-scale quantum (NISQ) hardware. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/TITANS-Lab-Artifacts/DP-QML-Health.
zh_abstract: 临床登记系统和可穿戴传感器支持早期健康风险评估，然而在这些记录上训练的模型在发布时可能泄漏敏感信息。差分隐私（DP）通过注入噪声来限制这种泄漏，噪声的总幅度随可训练参数数量增长，这一代价在小型健康队列中尤其严重。这促使采用参数高效模型，包括量子机器学习（QML），其变分电路可以用少量可训练参数表示复杂决策边界。这提出一个问题：在匹配输入维度和隐私预算时，量子模型是否比经典模型保留更多效用？我们在三个临床队列和一个可穿戴队列上研究该问题，将每条临床记录或每名参与者视为一个隐私单元。我们在五个隐私预算和五个随机种子下比较容量匹配的量子模型、多层感知机和逻辑回归模型。量子模型在三个临床队列上领先，按预算平均的 ROC AUC 最高领先 0.104；然而在可穿戴队列上落后，该队列参与者数量少，需要大量噪声。在 24 项检验中，经 Holm 校正后没有差异仍然显著，因此这些结果表明的是一种趋势，而非量子优势。一个解析梯度界表明，尽管存在裁剪偏差，较低的裁剪阈值可通过减少噪声提高效用。最后，在 IBM 量子计算机（ibm_fez，一台 156 量子比特超导处理器）上使用八个固定测试用例进行的实验，相对于模拟的平均绝对概率误差为 0.046（隐私）和 0.063（非隐私），支持在含噪中等规模量子（NISQ）硬件上进行推理的可行性。代码公开可用，见 https://github.com/TITANS-Lab-Artifacts/DP-QML-Health。

title: OpenMAP-HIE: Pathology Informed Score-based Diffusion Model for Unsupervised Neonatal Hypoxic-Ischemic Encephalopathy Lesion Segmentation
zh_title: OpenMAP-HIE：无监督新生儿HIE病灶定位
summary: 提出病理先验驱动的分数扩散模型，无需体素级标注即可在ADC图上定位新生儿缺氧缺血性脑病病灶。
key_points: 扩散模型学习健康新生儿ADC分布
用条件与无条件噪声预测差异作异常证据
无需体素级病灶监督，规避标注稀缺
reason: 方法有新意，但为预印本、未见外部验证，属值得一看档。
abstract: Accurate localization of neonatal hypoxic--ischemic encephalopathy (HIE) lesions on apparent diffusion coefficient (ADC) images is clinically important but is limited by scarce expert annotations and substantial variation in lesion appearance. We propose OpenMAP-HIE, a pathology-informed score-based diffusion model for unsupervised HIE lesion localization without voxel-wise lesion supervision. A denoising diffusion model learns the healthy neonatal ADC distribution, while a ControlNet-based conditional branch preserves patient-specific anatomy. At inference, anomaly evidence is derived directly from differences between conditional and unconditioned noise predictions at independently evaluated diffusion noise levels, avoiding dependence on a final pseudo-healthy reconstruction or sequential reverse-diffusion chain. Based on the characteristic ADC reduction associated with acute HIE, only discrepancies consistent with the expected pathological direction are retained and aggregated across noise levels using a geometric mean. Spatial mean filtering further suppresses isolated responses. The framework was evaluated on the BONBID-HIE dataset. The ADC-only method achieved a Dice score of $0.283\pm0.244$, average precision of $0.505$, Hausdorff distance of $25.45\pm15.63$ mm, mean average surface distance of $9.40\pm8.49$ mm, and normalized surface distance of $0.355\pm0.236$, providing the best overlap and surface-distance performance among the evaluated unsupervised methods and Dice performance comparable to supervised ADC-only models. Optional population-derived ADC $Z$-map refinement further increased Dice to $0.602\pm0.269$. These findings support pathology-informed score discrepancies as a useful signal for neonatal HIE lesion localization, while highlighting remaining challenges in detecting small and low-contrast lesions.
zh_abstract: 在表观扩散系数（apparent diffusion coefficient, ADC）图像上准确对新生儿缺氧缺血性脑病（hypoxic-ischemic encephalopathy, HIE）病灶进行定位具有重要临床意义，但受限于专家标注稀缺和病灶外观差异显著。我们提出 OpenMAP-HIE，一种病理信息驱动的基于分数的扩散模型，用于无需体素级病灶监督的无监督 HIE 病灶定位。去噪扩散模型学习健康新生儿 ADC 分布，而基于 ControlNet 的条件分支保留患者特异性解剖结构。在推理时，异常证据直接来自独立评估的扩散噪声水平下条件噪声预测与无条件噪声预测之间的差异，避免依赖最终伪健康重建或顺序反向扩散链。基于急性 HIE 相关的特征性 ADC 降低，仅保留与预期病理方向一致的差异，并使用几何平均跨噪声水平聚合。空间均值滤波进一步抑制孤立响应。该框架在 BONBID-HIE 数据集上进行了评估。仅 ADC 方法取得了 Dice 分数 $0.283\pm0.244$、平均精度 $0.505$、Hausdorff 距离 $25.45\pm15.63$ mm、平均平均表面距离 $9.40\pm8.49$ mm 和归一化表面距离 $0.355\pm0.236$，在评估的无监督方法中提供了最佳重叠和表面距离性能，并且 Dice 性能与仅 ADC 的监督模型相当。可选的人群衍生 ADC $Z$ 图细化进一步将 Dice 提高到 $0.602\pm0.269$。这些发现支持将病理信息驱动的分数差异作为新生儿 HIE 病灶定位的有用信号，同时强调在检测小病灶和低对比度病灶方面仍存在挑战。

title: From Scores to Safe Sets: Exact Safety--Constrained Decoding for Medication Recommendation
zh_title: 用药推荐中的精确安全约束解码
summary: 在MIMIC-III上固定药物分数，比较局部修复与整数规划全局解码，后者在DDI约束下Jaccard更高。
key_points: 以FLAME冻结分类器的固定药物分数输入
全局解码用混合整数线性规划选最优可行药物集
验证与测试集上均优于贪心及度数感知修复
reason: 单一数据库方法研究，有基线对比但无外部验证，属值得一看档。
abstract: Recent generative medication recommendation systems ultimately produce sets of drugs, but drug--drug interaction (DDI) constraints depend on the set as a whole. A natural post-hoc approach is to first predict medications and then locally repair interacting pairs by removing one drug at a time. We ask whether this local repair step itself introduces avoidable error. Using fixed medication scores from FLAME's frozen classifier on MIMIC-III, we compare increasingly strong local repair strategies with an exact global decoder while holding the scores, output size, and DDI constraint fixed. The global decoder jointly selects the highest-scoring feasible medication set using mixed-integer linear programming. Across validation and test splits, global decoding consistently achieves higher Jaccard similarity than greedy repair, degree-aware repair, and degree-aware repair strengthened with exhaustive 1-swap local search. Its advantage is small under loose DDI constraints and becomes larger as the constraint tightens; on the test split it reaches +0.0064 Jaccard over the strongest local baseline at the strict DDI operating point. The finding also holds across a fine accuracy--DDI sweep at matched realized DDI exposure and under three score representations. At the strict setting, global decoding retains more true-positive medications while removing more false positives. These results show that medication recommendation is not only a representation-learning problem: even with a frozen clinical model, how its scores are converted into a constrained medication set can materially affect the final prediction.
zh_abstract: 近期的生成式用药推荐系统最终产生药物集合，但药物-药物相互作用（drug-drug interaction, DDI）约束取决于整个集合。一种自然的事后方法是先预测药物，然后通过每次移除一种药物来局部修复相互作用的药物对。我们探究这一局部修复步骤本身是否会引入可避免的误差。使用 FLAME 冻结分类器在 MIMIC-III 上产生的固定用药分数，我们在保持分数、输出大小和 DDI 约束固定的情况下，将越来越强的局部修复策略与精确全局解码器进行比较。全局解码器使用混合整数线性规划联合选择得分最高的可行药物集合。在验证集和测试集划分上，全局解码始终比贪心修复、度感知修复以及通过穷举 1-交换局部搜索增强的度感知修复获得更高的 Jaccard 相似度。在宽松 DDI 约束下其优势较小，并随着约束收紧而增大；在测试集划分上，在严格 DDI 操作点处，它比最强的局部基线高出 +0.0064 Jaccard。该发现也在匹配实际 DDI 暴露下的精细准确率-DDI 扫描中以及三种分数表示下成立。在严格设置下，全局解码保留更多真阳性药物，同时移除更多假阳性。这些结果表明，用药推荐不仅是表征学习问题：即使使用冻结的临床模型，如何将其分数转换为受约束的药物集合也会实质影响最终预测。

title: Carving Radiology Reports at Their Evidential Joints: Anatomical Region Sets as Generation Units
zh_title: RadCarve：以解剖区域集为单元的放射报告生成
summary: 提出RadCarve，直接以现有陈述-解剖区域对应中的区域集作为生成单元，统一单元划分与视觉证据选择。
key_points: 生成单元定义来自报告已有区域对应关系
规划器用专用查询库联合预测单元存在性与区域组成
生成器按预测区域集的联合视觉证据逐单元生成文本
reason: 预印本方法创新且有对比，但证据限于报告生成指标，5档。
abstract: Organizing radiology reports into independently generated units offers a way to generate fine-grained clinical content and bind it to visual evidence. However, existing methods typically adopt generation-unit structures not directly specified in natural reports or their annotations, introducing additional modeling compromises. We propose RadCarve, which instead defines generation units directly from the anatomical region sets in existing statement-region correspondences, unifying unit formation with visual evidence selection. RadCarve's planner uses composition-specialized query banks to jointly predict unit existence and region composition from the image, iteratively refining both with regional evidence aggregated according to current membership predictions. The generator independently produces each unit's text conditioned on the joint visual evidence of its predicted region set. Compared with strong baselines, RadCarve improves CXRFEScore by 9.4% in unit generation given region sets and achieves 2.4 times the end-to-end binding F1. It also achieves leading report-generation results on Chest ImaGenome and PadChest-GR, using fewer than one-sixth as many parameters as large-scale baselines.
zh_abstract: 将放射学报告组织为独立生成的单元，提供了一种生成细粒度临床内容并将其绑定到视觉证据的方法。然而，现有方法通常采用自然报告或其标注中并未直接指定的生成单元结构，从而引入额外的建模妥协。我们提出 RadCarve，它转而直接从现有陈述-区域对应关系中的解剖区域集合定义生成单元，将单元形成与视觉证据选择统一起来。RadCarve 的规划器使用组合专用查询库，从图像中联合预测单元存在性和区域组成，并根据当前成员预测聚合的区域证据迭代细化二者。生成器以其预测区域集合的联合视觉证据为条件，独立生成每个单元的文本。与强基线相比，RadCarve 在给定区域集合的单元生成中将 CXRFEScore 提高 9.4%，并实现 2.4 倍的端到端绑定 F1。它还在 Chest ImaGenome 和 PadChest-GR 上取得领先的报告生成结果，使用的参数少于大规模基线的六分之一。

title: From Augmentation to Synthetic Evidence: Evaluating Generated Chest Radiographs at Dataset Intake
zh_title: 生成胸片在数据集入口的合成证据评估
summary: 研究生成胸片被当作真实检查记录的风险，用Qwen筛选、MedGemma质控与DINOv3来源分类器评估，筛选未改善双重检查通过率。
key_points: 区分质控通过、来源识别与真实记录支持
Qwen从1000候选选20张，质量筛选提升质控通过
未发现筛选能同时提高两项检查通过率
reason: 预印本，方法探索有意义但实验规模有限、无临床结局，属值得一看档
abstract: A generated chest radiograph can be useful as declared augmentation, but the same image becomes unsupported evidence when submitted as the record of a real examination. We study this problem by separating three questions: whether an image passes an automated quality check, whether an origin classifier flags it as generated, and whether a trusted record supports the claimed acquisition. In our experiments, Qwen selects up to 20 images from pools of 1,000 existing Cheff-identified or SynthCheX candidates. A receiver evaluates quality with MedGemma and predicted origin with a classifier on frozen DINOv3 features. Quality-based selection raises quality passes from 12 to 19 of 20 for Cheff-identified images and from 8 to 17 for SynthCheX. We find no evidence that selection improves passage through both checks: no selected Cheff-identified image passes both, while uniform, quality, and quality-constrained surrogate selection produce 2, 1, and 2 SynthCheX passes. On unprocessed test images, the origin classifier flags 4,677 of 5,000 SynthCheX images, but it also misclassify 110 of 2,297 NIH (real) images and 568 of 957 genuine images from another collection as fake. Our results further show that JPEG compression reduces SynthCheX-versus-NIH AUROC from 0.987 to 0.841. Even without processing, 152 SynthCheX images pass both pixel checks. These checks can filter submissions, but they cannot verify an acquisition claim. We strongly advocate that source and intended use must be recorded and checked separately for admission of chest radiographs in medical datasets.
zh_abstract: 生成的胸部 X 线片作为已声明的增强数据可能有用，但同一图像若作为真实检查记录提交，就成为无支持的证据。我们通过区分三个问题来研究这一问题：图像是否通过自动质量检查，来源分类器是否将其标记为生成图像，以及可信记录是否支持所声称的采集。在我们的实验中，Qwen 从 1,000 个现有 Cheff 识别或 SynthCheX 候选图像池中选择至多 20 张图像。接收方使用 MedGemma 评估质量，并使用基于冻结 DINOv3 特征的分类器评估预测来源。基于质量的选择使 Cheff 识别图像的质量通过数从 12/20 提高到 19/20，使 SynthCheX 从 8 提高到 17。我们未发现选择能改善通过两项检查的证据：没有选中的 Cheff 识别图像通过两项检查，而均匀选择、质量选择和质量约束替代选择分别产生 2 次、1 次和 2 次 SynthCheX 通过。在未处理的测试图像上，来源分类器将 5,000 张 SynthCheX 图像中的 4,677 张标记为生成，但也将 2,297 张 NIH（真实）图像中的 110 张以及来自另一集合的 957 张真实图像中的 568 张误分类为假。我们的结果进一步表明，JPEG 压缩将 SynthCheX 对 NIH 的 AUROC 从 0.987 降至 0.841。即使未经处理，仍有 152 张 SynthCheX 图像通过两项像素检查。这些检查可以过滤提交内容，但不能验证采集声明。我们强烈主张，在医学数据集中接纳胸部 X 线片时，必须分别记录并检查来源和预期用途。

title: Breast mammary gland dataset (BMGD): DAPI-stained fluorescent images for nuclei segmentation.
zh_title: 乳腺腺体数据集BMGD：DAPI染色细胞核分割
summary: 公开数据集BMGD含819个DAPI染色乳腺类器官图像块、逾9500个手工分割细胞核。
key_points: 面向深度学习细胞核分割的标注数据
覆盖多种培养刺激条件下的类器官
针对公开高质量标注数据稀缺问题
reason: 公开标注数据集，规模中等，属可一看的工具性资源
abstract: [Data in brief] Accurate segmentation of nuclei images is essential for analyzing cellular responses to perturbation in both in vitro and in vivo experiments. Although traditional methods, including watershed, thresholding, clustering, morphological operations, and active contour models, have long been used in segmenting nuclei in digital images, these methods are labor-intensive and time-consuming. Therefore, current research has shifted to deep learning techniques for improved nuclei segmentation. However, training deep learning models requires high-quality annotated ground-truth datasets, which are often scarce and not available for public use. In this study, we introduce the Breast Mammary Gland Dataset (BMGD), an annotated collection of DAPI-stained nuclei images of mammary organoids. The dataset contains 819 image patches with >9500 manually segmented nuclei cultured in various stiffness conditions. Each original image in the BMGD is paired with one carefully annotated ground-truth mask. This dataset will enable researchers to develop and evaluate automated nuclei segmentation algorithms, particularly for studying cellular responses in breast cancer research and treatment.
zh_abstract: [Data in brief] 细胞核图像的准确分割对于分析体外和体内实验中对扰动的细胞反应至关重要。尽管传统方法，包括分水岭、阈值化、聚类、形态学操作和活动轮廓模型，长期以来一直用于数字图像中的细胞核分割，但这些方法劳动强度大且耗时。因此，当前研究已转向深度学习技术以改进细胞核分割。然而，训练深度学习模型需要高质量的标注真实数据集，而这些数据集往往稀缺且不可公开使用。在本研究中，我们介绍乳腺腺体数据集（Breast Mammary Gland Dataset，BMGD），这是一个经标注的乳腺类器官DAPI染色细胞核图像集合。该数据集包含819个图像块，其中有>9500个在不同硬度条件下培养并手动分割的细胞核。BMGD中的每张原始图像均配有一个经过仔细标注的真实掩膜。该数据集将使研究人员能够开发和评估自动细胞核分割算法，特别是用于研究乳腺癌研究和治疗中的细胞反应。

title: A Multi-Agent Framework for Automated Machine Learning with Evidence-based Planning for Medical Image Analysis
zh_title: MedicalMLOmni：面向医学影像的循证规划多智能体AutoML框架
summary: 提出多智能体AutoML框架，通过自然语言接口并检索已发表结果规划模型选择，覆盖多种医学影像任务。
key_points: 针对通用AutoML缺乏医学架构与预处理的痛点
通过检索文献结果进行循证规划，指导模型选择与配置
覆盖单模态与多模态医学任务，经自然语言接口调用
reason: 多智能体AutoML新方法预印本，方法有新意，但证据与验证信息有限
abstract: Deep learning has become the default tool for medical image analysis, driven by the open-source movement. However, achieving the best performance on a given task remains difficult, with architecture selection and hyperparameter optimization (HPO) still considered "more of an art than a science". Automated machine learning (AutoML) automates parts of model training, yet helps little in medical imaging: general-purpose approaches lack medical architectures and preprocessing, and medical-focused ones demand engineering expertise and remain confined to narrow tasks such as 3D segmentation. We introduce MedicalMLOmni, a multi-agent AutoML framework that automates model training for diverse single- and multi-modal medical tasks through a natural language interface. Specifically, MedicalMLOmni performs evidence-based planning by retrieving published results to guide model selection and configuration, and employs parallel HPO where multiple agents explore adjustment strategies concurrently. MedicalMLOmni achieves the best score on 19 of 20 benchmarks; PMC-VQA is the exception, where a vision-language model with broader pre-training leads. Backbone-matched controls attribute the gains to the framework, not the backbone. By removing coding requirements, MedicalMLOmni lowers the barrier for domain experts with rich datasets but limited engineering expertise.
zh_abstract: 深度学习已成为医学图像分析的默认工具，这一趋势由开源运动推动。然而，在给定任务上取得最佳性能仍然困难，架构选择和超参数优化（HPO）仍被视为“更像艺术而非科学”。自动化机器学习（AutoML）实现了模型训练部分环节的自动化，但在医学影像中帮助不大：通用方法缺乏医学架构和预处理，而面向医学的方法需要工程专业知识，且仍局限于3D分割等狭窄任务。我们介绍MedicalMLOmni，这是一个多智能体AutoML框架，通过自然语言接口为多样化的单模态和多模态医学任务自动化模型训练。具体而言，MedicalMLOmni通过检索已发表结果来指导模型选择和配置，进行基于证据的规划，并采用并行HPO，其中多个智能体同时探索调整策略。MedicalMLOmni在20个基准中的19个上取得最佳分数；PMC-VQA是例外，在该基准上具有更广泛预训练的视觉-语言模型领先。骨干网络匹配的对照将增益归因于框架，而非骨干网络。通过消除编码要求，MedicalMLOmni降低了拥有丰富数据集但工程专业知识有限的领域专家的门槛。

title: IECG: Weakly-Supervised Interpretability-Enhancing Foundation Model for Electrocardiogram
zh_title: IECG：弱监督可解释心电基础模型
summary: 提出弱监督心电基础模型，借助临床先验生成的异常热图伪标签同时做诊断分类与异常定位。
key_points: 无需人工标注异常区段即可定位异常波形
用临床知识生成热图伪标签引导注意力
预训练结合心电-文本对比对齐与注意力监督
reason: 有新意的可解释心电基础模型预印本，但未给出外部验证或公开权重信息
abstract: Electrocardiography (ECG) is a cornerstone of cardiac diagnosis, yet most machine learning methods for ECG analysis lack interpretability, limiting their clinical adoption. We present IECG, a weakly-supervised ECG foundation model that jointly performs diagnostic classification and abnormality localization without requiring manual abnormal region annotations, overcoming a long-standing bottleneck in interpretable ECG learning. Central to IECG is a weakly-supervised attention strategy that explicitly incorporates clinical priors by deriving abnormality heatmap pseudo-labels from established ECG clinical knowledge. These pseudo-labels guide the model's CLS-token attention through a KL-divergence loss, encouraging it to focus on diagnostically relevant waveform regions. During pretraining, IECG is jointly optimized with clinically guided attention supervision, ECG-text contrastive alignment, and report captioning objectives, enabling it to learn rich multimodal representations while producing localized waveform evidence. By explicitly aggregating features from clinically guided attention regions, IECG grounds its diagnostic predictions in interpretable waveform evidence without sacrificing classification performance. Extensive experiments demonstrate that IECG achieves state-of-the-art abnormal region localization while maintaining strong classification performance, advancing trustworthy foundation models for ECG analysis.
zh_abstract: 心电图（ECG）是心脏诊断的基石，但大多数用于 ECG 分析的机器学习方法缺乏可解释性，限制了其临床采用。我们提出 IECG，一种弱监督 ECG 基础模型，可联合执行诊断分类和异常定位，且无需人工异常区域标注，从而克服了可解释 ECG 学习中长期存在的瓶颈。IECG 的核心是一种弱监督注意力策略，该策略通过从既有的 ECG 临床知识中推导异常热图伪标签，显式融入临床先验。这些伪标签通过 KL 散度损失引导模型的 CLS-token 注意力，促使其关注具有诊断相关性的波形区域。在预训练期间，IECG 通过临床引导的注意力监督、ECG-文本对比对齐和报告描述目标进行联合优化，使其能够在学习丰富的多模态表示的同时生成局部波形证据。通过显式聚合来自临床引导注意力区域的特征，IECG 将其诊断预测建立在可解释的波形证据之上，而不牺牲分类性能。大量实验表明，IECG 在保持强大分类性能的同时实现了最先进的异常区域定位，推动了用于 ECG 分析的可信基础模型的发展。

title: Bypassing Current Biosecurity Screens with AI Designed Proteins and Closing the Gap with Edge-AI Functional Screening
zh_title: AI 设计蛋白绕过生物安全筛查与边缘 AI 检测
summary: 预印本展示 AI 设计蛋白可绕过序列筛查，并提出离线边缘 AI 系统 Capiti 检测致病功能。
key_points: 序列比对筛查易受 AI 重设计攻击
Capiti 离线监听合成仪阀门信号并中止
用 ProteinMPNN 变体训练 CNN 识别折叠
reason: 预印本提出新检测系统与攻击评估，但尚无外部验证，值得一看。
abstract: DNA synthesis machines are vital tools in medicine and research, but they can be misused to produce sequences which are transcribed and translated to produce toxic proteins. Synthesis providers may screen orders for dangerous sequences, but most screening software performs sequence-based alignment, which is vulnerable to AI redesign attacks. Additionally, software-only synthesis screening requires the operator of the machine to be trusted. We present Capiti, an edge-deployed screening system that runs with no internet connection, listens directly to a synthesizer's valve control signals, and aborts a run when it detects incipient pathogenic function. Rather than performing sequence alignment, Capiti is specifically trained to recognize fold. ProteinMPNN was used to generate putatively functional variants of known pathogenic proteins, and a CNN was trained to separate them from active-site knockouts, scrambles, and decoys. We release two models, Capiti-E (known pathogenic proteins) and Capiti-C (resistance genes for antibiotics of last resort), alongside emusynth, a DNA synthesizer emulator. On our test sets, IBBIS commec and SeqScreen incorrectly passed 18.5% and 44.7% of putatively functional pathogenic variants respectively; Capiti passed 0.24%.
zh_abstract: DNA 合成机器是医学和研究中的重要工具，但它们可能被滥用来生产可被转录和翻译以产生毒性蛋白的序列。合成服务提供方可能会筛查订单中的危险序列，但大多数筛查软件执行基于序列的比对，易受 AI 重设计攻击。此外，纯软件合成筛查要求机器操作员可信。我们提出 Capiti，一种边缘部署的筛查系统，无需互联网连接运行，直接监听合成仪的阀门控制信号，并在检测到早期致病功能时中止运行。Capiti 不执行序列比对，而是专门训练用于识别折叠。使用 ProteinMPNN 生成已知致病蛋白的推定功能性变体，并训练 CNN 将其与活性位点敲除、乱序序列和诱饵区分开。我们发布两个模型：Capiti-E（已知致病蛋白）和 Capiti-C（最后防线抗生素的耐药基因），以及 DNA 合成仪模拟器 emusynth。在我们的测试集上，IBBIS commec 和 SeqScreen 分别错误放行了 18.5% 和 44.7% 的推定功能性致病变体；Capiti 放行了 0.24%。

title: In Other Words: Learning When to Trust Generated Protein Function Descriptions
zh_title: 蛋白质功能描述生成的可信度自评估
summary: bioRxiv预印本提出LLM等价性评判器与ProtTale序列到文本模型，可自估可靠性并提升各方法精度。
key_points: 用LLM评判器对齐专家盲审标注
ProtTale自估可靠性指标pJay
短蛋白上使各方法精度近翻倍
reason: 预印本新方法有基线对比与专家验证，但无大规模外部验证，属值得一看档。
abstract: Generative protein-to-text models write function descriptions in free-form English but give no indication of which to believe. Indeed, free text is hard to evaluate. We introduce a large language model judge of equivalence of predicted vs. ''true'' function descriptions, validated against blinded expert curation. We also present ProtTale, our sequence-to-text model, that learns from the judge's verdicts to estimate its own reliability, pJay. On unseen Swiss-Prot enzymes, ProtTale and three other leading methods tie on accuracy but are right about different proteins. Here, ProtTale's unique correct predictions outnumber all other methods' combined. Scored from sequence alone, pJay is a plug-in filter, raising all models' performance. On short proteins, it raises precision for every tested method nearly twofold. We argue that generative annotation becomes useful not by being right more often, but by knowing when it can be trusted---a standard that every generative model in biology should meet.
zh_abstract: 生成式蛋白到文本模型用自由形式的英语书写功能描述，但不指示哪些内容可信。事实上，自由文本难以评估。我们引入一个大型语言模型评判器，用于评判预测功能描述与“真实”功能描述的等价性，并针对盲法专家整理进行验证。我们还提出 ProtTale，我们的序列到文本模型，它从评判器的判定中学习以估计自身可靠性 pJay。在未见的 Swiss-Prot 酶上，ProtTale 和另外三种领先方法在准确率上持平，但正确判断的蛋白不同。在此，ProtTale 独有的正确预测数量超过所有其他方法的总和。仅从序列评分时，pJay 是一个即插即用过滤器，可提高所有模型的性能。在短蛋白上，它使每个受测方法的精确率提高到近两倍。我们认为，生成式注释变得有用并非因为更经常正确，而是因为知道何时可以信任——这是生物学中每个生成式模型都应达到的标准。

title: Convergent Performance, Divergent Mechanisms in LoRA-Adapted Vision Foundation Models for Brain MRI
zh_title: 脑MRI视觉基础模型LoRA适配机制分析
summary: 分析四种ViT主干经LoRA适配脑肿瘤分割后性能趋同但内部表征变化不同，并评估六个数据集。
key_points: 比较自然与医学预训练的四类主干
分割Dice相近但注意力与权重变化不同
同时评估分割与阿尔茨海默病分类
reason: 预印本多数据集分析，有机制洞察但无外部临床验证
abstract: Adapting Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) to medical imaging via LoRA has become standard practice, yet model selection is guided almost entirely by downstream task metrics, treating backbones with similar performance as interchangeable. We investigate whether equal performance implies equal internal representational shift. We analyse four ViT-B/16 backbones, DINOv3, SigLIP2, MerMED-FM, and BiomedCLIP, pre-trained with different objectives (self-distillation vs. contrastive vision-language) and on different data domains (natural vs. medical images). We adapt each to brain tumour segmentation and evaluate on six datasets covering both segmentation and Alzheimer's disease classification. Using attention divergence, weight-change analysis, and activation patching, we find that the four models converge to similar segmentation performance (mean Dice 78-81%) through markedly different internal dynamics, yet diverge in cross-task transfer: segmentation adaptation improves Alzheimer's disease classification for DINOv3 but degrades it for the other three backbones. We reveal a dissociation between modification magnitude and causal importance: the most heavily modified layers are not the causally relevant ones, with early-to-mid layers identified as sufficient for segmentation recovery. Restricting LoRA to these layers matches or approaches full-layer segmentation while reducing classification degradation in the three affected backbones, providing a mechanistically grounded strategy that is more parameter-efficient and more robust than standard full-layer adaptation.
zh_abstract: 将视觉基础模型（Vision Foundation Models, VFMs）通过 LoRA 适配到医学影像已成为标准做法，然而模型选择几乎完全由下游任务指标主导，性能相近的骨干网络被当作可互换的。我们研究性能相同是否意味着内部表征偏移也相同。我们分析了四个 ViT-B/16 骨干网络：DINOv3、SigLIP2、MerMED-FM 和 BiomedCLIP，它们以不同的预训练目标（自蒸馏 vs. 对比式视觉-语言）并在不同的数据域（自然图像 vs. 医学图像）上预训练。我们将每个模型适配到脑肿瘤分割任务，并在涵盖分割与阿尔茨海默病分类的六个数据集上进行评估。利用注意力散度、权重变化分析和激活修补（activation patching），我们发现这四个模型通过显著不同的内部动力学收敛到相似的分割性能（平均 Dice 78-81%），但在跨任务迁移上出现分化：分割适配改善了 DINOv3 的阿尔茨海默病分类，却使其他三个骨干网络的表现下降。我们揭示了修改幅度与因果重要性之间的分离：被修改最多的层并非因果相关的层，早期至中层被确定为足以恢复分割性能。将 LoRA 限制在这些层，可在三个受影响的骨干网络上匹配或接近全层分割的效果，同时减少分类性能退化，从而提供了一种有机制依据的策略，比标准的全层适配更参数高效、也更稳健。

title: When Do Humans and Machines Truly Complement Each Other? Formal Conditions and Empirical Evidence for Human-AI Synergy
zh_title: 人与机器何时真正互补：协同的形式条件与证据
summary: 预印本提出以依赖模式建模人机交互，推导人机协同的充要条件，即相互纠错能力。
key_points: 从依赖模式刻画人与算法决策的联合正确性
给出协同产生的数学充要条件
为决策支持系统设计与评估提供基础
reason: 形式化框架有新意但为预印本、缺具体临床验证
abstract: Can humans and artificial intelligence cooperate such that their combination yields greater accuracy than either agent alone? This result, termed \emph{synergy} or \emph{complementarity}, is notoriously difficult to achieve, even when both agents possess significant independent accuracy. In this paper, we present a formal framework to model human-AI interaction through the lens of reliance patterns, which characterize the joint correctness structure of human and algorithmic decisions. We derive mathematically necessary and sufficient conditions for synergy, demonstrating that its emergence depends on the ability of either agent to identify and correct the errors of the other, what we call Human and Algorithmic Correction. Beyond its theoretical contribution, the proposed framework provides a foundation for the design and evaluation of knowledge-based decision support systems, where interaction policies must dynamically integrate heterogeneous sources of expertise. We demonstrate this through the analysis of seven clinical case studies. Our empirical results reveal a ``dominance trap,'' where a strong algorithmic advantage can paradoxically inhibit synergy by eroding human corrective intervention. We also show that synergy can persist even in the presence of cognitive biases, such as automation bias, provided there is functional de-correlation between human and AI errors. These results provide a formal foundation for key concepts in the human-AI systems literature and offer actionable insights for designing interaction-centric AI systems that foster complementarity.
zh_abstract: 人类与人工智能能否合作，使二者的组合比任一单独主体获得更高的准确率？这一结果被称为协同（synergy）或互补（complementarity），即便两个主体都具备显著的独立准确率，这一结果也以难以实现而著称。在本文中，我们提出一个形式化框架，从依赖模式（reliance patterns）的视角对人类-AI 交互进行建模，这些模式刻画了人类决策与算法决策的联合正确性结构。我们推导出协同的数学必要条件和充分条件，证明协同的出现取决于任一主体识别并纠正另一方错误的能力，我们称之为人类纠正与算法纠正（Human and Algorithmic Correction）。除理论贡献外，所提出的框架为基于知识的决策支持系统的设计与评估提供了基础，在这类系统中，交互策略必须动态整合异构的专业知识来源。我们通过七个临床案例研究的分析对此加以验证。我们的实证结果揭示了一个“主导陷阱”（dominance trap），即强大的算法优势反而会侵蚀人类的纠正性干预，从而悖论性地抑制协同。我们还表明，即使存在自动化偏差等认知偏差，只要人类错误与 AI 错误之间存在功能性去相关，协同仍可持续存在。这些结果为人类-AI 系统文献中的关键概念提供了形式化基础，并为设计以交互为中心、促进互补性的 AI 系统提供了可操作的洞见。

title: CPVB-RG: Cross-Prior Visual Bridging for Prior-Aware Chest X-Ray Report Generation
zh_title: CPVB-RG：融合既往影像的胸片报告生成
summary: 提出先验感知框架，用跨先验视觉桥对比间期进展与稳定解剖，结合临床文本生成随访胸片报告。
key_points: 进展引导焦点注意力对比间期变化与共享空间
交叉注意力单元连接纵向视觉证据与临床语义
两阶段训练，输入当前与既往影像及可用文本
reason: 预印本方法研究，纵向对比思路有新意但无外部验证，5档。
abstract: Radiologists interpret follow-up chest X-rays by comparing current and prior examinations to identify new, resolved or progressing findings. Most report generation systems either omit this longitudinal context or fuse prior features without distinguishing interval changes from anatomy that remains stable over time. We propose CPVB-RG, a prior-aware framework that combines current and prior radiographs with available clinical text. Its Cross-Prior Visual Bridge (CPVB) contains Progression-Guided Focus Attention (PGFA) and two Cross-Attention units. PGFA is designed to contrast progression-difference attention with shared-spatial attention, aiming to reduce invariant responses whilst retaining coarse spatial correspondence between examinations. The Cross-Attention units then connect the resulting longitudinal visual evidence with clinical semantics. CPVB-RG is trained in two stages, using prior-guided image-text alignment followed by autoregressive report generation with a lightweight language decoder. Experiments on MIMIC-CXR and IU X-Ray show consistent improvements across language and clinical metrics. On MIMIC-CXR, CPVB-RG achieves 0.2847 F1RadGraph and 0.6692 VLScore, with statistically significant gains over the closest decoder-matched prior-aware baseline. These results support the effectiveness of the proposed difference-aware and spatially guided fusion design for prior-aware chest X-ray report generation.
zh_abstract: 放射科医师通过比较当前和既往检查来解读随访胸部X线，以识别新出现、已消退或进展的发现。大多数报告生成系统要么省略这种纵向背景，要么融合既往特征而未区分间期变化与随时间保持稳定的解剖结构。我们提出CPVB-RG，一个先验感知框架，将当前和既往X线片与可用的临床文本相结合。其跨先验视觉桥（Cross-Prior Visual Bridge, CPVB）包含进展引导聚焦注意力（Progression-Guided Focus Attention, PGFA）和两个交叉注意力单元。PGFA旨在将进展差异注意力与共享空间注意力进行对比，目标是减少不变响应，同时保留检查之间的粗粒度空间对应关系。交叉注意力单元随后将得到的纵向视觉证据与临床语义连接起来。CPVB-RG分两阶段训练，先使用先验引导的图像-文本对齐，随后使用轻量级语言解码器进行自回归报告生成。在MIMIC-CXR和IU X-Ray上的实验显示，在语言和临床指标上均有一致改善。在MIMIC-CXR上，CPVB-RG达到0.2847 F1RadGraph和0.6692 VLScore，相较于最接近的解码器匹配的先验感知基线具有统计学显著增益。这些结果支持所提出的差异感知和空间引导融合设计在先验感知胸部X线报告生成中的有效性。

title: AdaptMIL: Domain Adaptation for Multiple Instance Learning in Digital Pathology
zh_title: AdaptMIL：数字病理多实例学习的域适应方法
summary: 提出AdaptMIL两阶段训练策略，将表征层域对齐与MIL聚合学习解耦，缓解跨医院分布偏移导致的性能下降。
key_points: 针对病理基础模型跨医院分布偏移下性能退化问题
发现在MIL训练中直接施加域适应目标会干扰聚合学习
两阶段训练解耦域对齐与MIL聚合
reason: 预印本新方法，问题明确但仅见摘要，缺乏外部验证与量化结果，属值得一看档
abstract: Pathology foundation models (PFMs) support a wide range of histopathology tasks on whole-slide images through multiple instance learning (MIL). Despite recent progress, these models remain sensitive to cross-hospital distribution shifts: performance often degrades when a task head (e.g., classification) is trained on data from one hospital and then used on data from another hospital. To address this challenge, we propose AdaptMIL, a training strategy for integrating domain adaptation into MIL training. AdaptMIL is motivated by our finding that directly applying domain adaptation objectives during MIL training can interfere with MIL aggregation learning, often resulting in performance degradation over standard training. AdaptMIL resolves this by decoupling representation-level domain alignment learning from MIL aggregation learning through a two-stage training procedure. We show that AdaptMIL improves cross-hospital performance and outperforms alternative adaptation methods across experiments spanning multiple WSI datasets, tasks, PFMs, MIL architectures, and domain adaptation objectives. AdaptMIL's code will be released upon publication.
zh_abstract: 病理基础模型（pathology foundation models, PFMs）通过多实例学习（multiple instance learning, MIL）支持全切片图像上的广泛组织病理学任务。尽管近期取得了进展，这些模型仍对跨医院分布偏移敏感：当任务头（例如分类）在一家医院的数据上训练、随后用于另一家医院的数据时，性能常会下降。为应对这一挑战，我们提出 AdaptMIL，一种将域适应整合到 MIL 训练中的训练策略。AdaptMIL 的动机来自我们的发现：在 MIL 训练期间直接应用域适应目标会干扰 MIL 聚合学习，常导致相较标准训练的性能下降。AdaptMIL 通过两阶段训练流程，将表示层面的域对齐学习与 MIL 聚合学习解耦，从而解决该问题。我们表明，在跨越多个 WSI 数据集、任务、PFM、MIL 架构和域适应目标的实验中，AdaptMIL 提升了跨医院性能，并优于其他适应方法。AdaptMIL 的代码将在论文发表后发布。

title: Beyond the Evidence Boundary: Behavioral Mirage Under Progressive Degradation in Medical VLMs
zh_title: 医学视觉语言模型在证据渐进退化下的行为评估框架
summary: 提出以基线正确病例为锚的框架，通过渐进图像退化定位证据边界，并定义模型仍持续作答的“幻象”行为。
key_points: 以基线正确病例为锚追踪渐进图像退化轨迹
定义证据边界处仍坚持作答的“mirage”行为

abstract: VLMs for medical image interpretation are typically evaluated on clean inputs, despite the progressive evidence loss that can occur in high stakes clinical settings. Existing robustness studies show that performance can degrade while confidence remains high, but do not establish when a previously reliable model-case pair ceases to behave reliably. We introduce a baseline-anchored framework that traces baseline-correct cases through progressive image degradation to identify an empirical evidence boundary, and define mirage as continued commitment at this boundary, regardless of correctness. Across three VLMs on three medical datasets, only MedGemma provides a sufficiently large baseline-correct pool for trajectory analysis. On VQA-RAD, the only dataset in which the question text varies, language-only answerability is associated with baseline correctness (AUROC 0.677) and with commitment at the boundary (AUROC 0.653 to 0.670). MedGemma's post-boundary behavior is heterogeneous, including direct mirage, correct recovery, mirage dissolution, consistent abstention, and oscillation, with mirage rates of 16.0 to 100.0% across dataset-modality pairs. Despite this behavioral heterogeneity, residual-stream probes decode commit-versus-abstain behavior at the boundary with AUROC of 0.895 to 0.994 under nested cross-validation. These results show that progressive evidence loss can produce persistent commitment that output entropy and abstention behavior do not consistently reflect, motivating boundary-aware evaluation, option-order controls, and improved abstention mechanisms for reliable medical foundation models operating under partial observation.

Adults with coronary plaque on baseline coronary CT angiography (CCTA) and at least one follow-up CCTA obtained between January 1, 2020 and December 31, 2025 will be identified from participating centers. The system will integrate clinical factors, CCTA plaque morphology and burden, functional measures, hemodynamic parameters, and biomechanical features using baseline data. abstract: [ANS. Advances in nursing science] Convergent Care Theory (CCT) proposes that optimal outcomes are achieved through the convergence of interdependent dimensions of care within a culture of caring. CCT 2.0 responds to the integration of artificial intelligence (AI) into care through 5 domains: organizational care, collaborative care, human-centered care, self-care, and AI-powered care. abstract: [Clinical & translational oncology : official publication of the Federation of Spanish Oncology Societies and of the National Cancer Institute of Mexico] Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly transforming diagnosis, treatment selection, prognostic assessment, and administrative work in medicine. Although these technologies may improve efficiency and clinical performance, their integration also raises questions about medical humanism, professional responsibility, and the physician-patient relationship. This narrative historical review examines the contributions of Hippocrates, Asclepiades, Galen, Avicenna, and Maimonides to the relationship between medical knowledge, clinical judgment, and moral responsibility, and considers how these historical traditions may inform contemporary debates on AI in medicine and oncology. Primary historical texts and secondary scholarly literature were examined through a targeted, non-systematic approach, with emphasis on clinical observation, therapeutic responsibility, the physician-patient relationship, and the ethical purposes of medicine. The analysis identifies three normative themes of contemporary relevance: the non-delegable responsibility of the physician, the relational and contextual nature of clinical reasoning, and the ethical limits of technological optimization. Contemporary philosophy of medicine and recent AI ethics literature provide a conceptual bridge between these historical traditions and current technological practice. This bridge might be the source of a lack of humanism in daily practice and a deterioration in patient-physician relationship. In oncology, these principles related to AI use are particularly relevant to AI-assisted imaging and pathology, molecular profiling, treatment selection, prognostic prediction, and shared decision-making. AI should, therefore, be understood as a clinical instrument whose value depends not only on technical performance, but also on its integration into relationships of trust, accountability, and patient-centered care.

abstract: Background. Research data enclaves such as the All of Us Research Program do not allow participant-level data, or models fitted to them, to leave, which makes it hard to deliver case-finding models, which flag patients with possibly uncoded conditions for clinician review, to patients and clinicians. Objectives. We describe and technically evaluate a system that fits models outside an enclave from released summary counts and delivers them through standard health information technology interfaces. Methods. We exported dissemination-compliant summary counts from the All of Us Researcher Workbench and, outside the enclave, fitted versioned models for Long COVID, chronic fatigue, fibromyalgia, endometriosis, Lyme disease, lupus, migraine, depression, and anxiety. A model contract (a model file and a written specification), a Python reference implementation, and synthetic Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources (FHIR) test patients define the expected outputs. One JavaScript scorer runs in a patient demonstration, a SMART on FHIR clinician application, and a CDS Hooks service. An atlas displays aggregate results. We evaluated the system on synthetic records with automated tests, cross-implementation output comparison, launches through the public SMART sandbox, and a counterexample review of the scoring and display rules. Results. The deployed Long COVID model had an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.67 in a random validation split. The eight self-report models reached 0.61 to 0.82 in identifying self-reporters without a code. The JavaScript scorer reproduced all 162 reference outputs exactly, and all 437 automated tests passed. A counterexample review found 5 classes of failure, including scoring ineligible patients and treating unavailable data as absent, all fixed and added as tests. Conclusions. Models fitted from released summary counts can be delivered through FHIR, SMART on FHIR, and CDS Hooks with reproducible scoring on synthetic records. Real-record interoperability, usability, and prospective clinical performance remain to be evaluated.

title: MedBOE: Optimization-Based Estimation of Complete Patient Body Models from Whole-Body Medical Imaging
zh_title: MedBOE：基于优化从全身影像估计完整人体模型
summary: 提出无需训练、基于优化的自动化框架，从全身医学影像中补全缺失体部，估计完整患者体表模型。
key_points: 扫描孔径与体位常导致侧臂、手等体部缺失

abstract: True whole-body medical imaging captures a patient from head to toe and provides comprehensive anatomical and/or functional information. This coverage enables reconstruction of the external body surface, yielding patient body models. However, scanner geometry (e.g., bore diameter), patient characteristics, and positioning can leave body regions missing (e.g., lateral arms/torso, hands, forearms, elbows), producing incomplete patient body models. Such incompleteness limits downstream medical analyses, including derivation of body-habitus metrics (BHMs), such as body volume and surface area, for injected radiotracer activity regimens, cardiometabolic risk assessment, and computational anatomical modeling for medical imaging simulation and radiation dosimetry. We present the Medical Body model Optimization-based Estimator (MedBOE), an automated, training-free framework for estimating complete patient body models from whole-body images with missing body regions. Our innovation is to leverage the Skinned Multi-Person Linear (SMPL) template, a parametric body mesh representing a broad range of body shapes and poses, in medical imaging. MedBOE aligns the SMPL template to the incomplete patient body models via attribute-guided optimization and estimates missing body regions through geometrically and volumetrically constrained deformation. We evaluated MedBOE using two public datasets: AutoPET (91 whole-body PET-CT images) and Human Implicit Tissues (HIT; 40 whole-body segmentations from MRI images). MedBOE achieved the best overall volumetric and geometric performance among evaluated methods. BHMs derived from MedBOE were within 2% error, suggesting low percentage errors for downstream analyses. MedBOE offers an automated, training-free method for estimating complete patient body models from whole-body images with missing body regions.
zh_abstract: 真正的全身医学影像从头顶到脚底捕获患者，并提供全面的解剖和/或功能信息。这种覆盖范围能够重建外部体表，从而生成患者身体模型。然而，扫描仪几何结构（例如，孔径）、患者特征和摆位可能导致身体区域缺失（例如，侧向手臂/躯干、手、前臂、肘部），从而产生不完整的患者身体模型。这种不完整性限制了下游医学分析，包括推导身体习惯指标（body-habitus metrics，BHMs），如身体体积和表面积，用于注射放射性示踪剂活度方案、心脏代谢风险评估，以及用于医学影像模拟和辐射剂量学的计算解剖建模。我们提出医学身体模型优化估计器（Medical Body model Optimization-based Estimator，MedBOE），这是一种自动化、无需训练的框架，用于从存在身体区域缺失的全身影像中估计完整的患者身体模型。我们的创新在于将蒙皮多人线性（Skinned Multi-Person Linear，SMPL）模板——一种参数化身体网格，可表示广泛的身体形状和姿势——应用于医学影像。MedBOE通过属性引导优化将SMPL模板与不完整患者身体模型对齐，并通过几何和体积约束的变形估计缺失身体区域。我们使用两个公开数据集评估MedBOE：AutoPET（91幅全身PET-CT图像）和Human Implicit Tissues（HIT；来自MRI图像的40个全身分割）。在评估的方法中，MedBOE取得了最佳的总体体积和几何性能。由MedBOE推导的BHMs误差在2%以内，提示下游分析的百分比误差较低。MedBOE提供了一种自动化、无需训练的方法，用于从存在身体区域缺失的全身影像中估计完整的患者身体模型。
